definition_zh: 反驳；否认；与……相矛盾；自相矛盾
definition_en: to say the opposite of what someone has said, or to be inconsistent with something else
core_image: 两支箭头从同一点射出，指向完全相反的两个方向
scene: 法庭上，证人先说是九点，随后又改口说是十一点。律师说： You just contradicted your earlier statement.
sceneCN: 这里 contradict 是「反驳、自相矛盾」（第 1 个义项：说出相反的话）；句意：你刚刚与先前的陈述自相矛盾。

derivatives.zh: 矛盾；反驳；矛盾之处
相互矛盾的；对立的
反驳者；提出相反说法的人
自相矛盾

senses.title: Say the opposite of what someone said
senses.titleCN: 反驳：把对方的话反过来说
senses.definition: to state that what someone has just said is wrong, and give the opposite account
senses.definitionCN: 指出某人刚说的话是错的，并给出相反的说法
senses.example: She contradicted him in front of the whole committee.
senses.exampleCN: 她当着整个委员会的面反驳了他。
senses.why: Latin contra dicere is literally 'to speak against'. The word does not merely disagree; it places a second statement directly opposite the first.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 contra dicere 字面就是“反着说”。这个词不只是不同意，而是把第二句话直接放在第一句话的对面。

senses.title: Of statements: be inconsistent
senses.titleCN: 相互矛盾：两句话不能同时成立
senses.definition: of two statements or facts, to be incompatible so that both cannot be true at once
senses.definitionCN: （两句话或两个事实）互不相容，不能同时为真
senses.example: The two reports contradict each other on the date.
senses.exampleCN: 两份报告在日期上互相矛盾。
senses.why: When two statements are set opposite each other, there is no ground on which both can stand. This 'be inconsistent with' sense is recorded from about 1600.
senses.whyCN: 当两句话被放到彼此对面，就没有任何一块地面能让两者同时站住。这一“与……不一致”义约记录于 1600 年。

senses.title: Deny a claim or an accusation
senses.definition: to deny the truth of a claim, accusation or rumour
senses.definitionCN: 否认某项主张、指控或传闻的真实性
senses.example: The company contradicted the rumour of a merger.
senses.exampleCN: 公司否认了合并的传闻。
senses.why: The sense 'deny the words or assertions of' is recorded from about 1600. Denial is the negative half of speaking against.
senses.whyCN: “否认某人的话或断言”这一义项约记录于 1600 年。否认是“反着说”的否定那一半。

senses.title: Contradict oneself
senses.titleCN: 自相矛盾：自己前后打起来
senses.definition: to make two statements that cannot both be true, so that one cancels the other
senses.definitionCN: 说出两句不能同时为真的话，使一句抵消另一句
senses.example: He contradicted himself twice during the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 他在采访中两次自相矛盾。
senses.why: The reflexive form turns the opposition inward: the speaker is now both parties, and the two statements pull against each other inside one mouth.
senses.whyCN: 反身形式把对立转向内部：说话者现在同时是两方，两句话在同一张嘴里面互相拉扯。

senses.title: Contradictory: mutually opposed
senses.definition: the adjective describes two things that cannot both be true or both be accepted
senses.definitionCN: 形容词描述两件不能同时为真或同时被接受的事
senses.example: The witness gave two contradictory accounts.
senses.exampleCN: 证人给出了两份相互矛盾的陈述。
senses.why: The -ory suffix marks a relation of opposition: each item points away from the other, like the two arrows from one point.
senses.whyCN: -ory 后缀标记对立关系：两项各自背离对方，就像从同一点射出的两支反向箭头。

senses.title: Contradiction: the opposing statement
senses.definition: the noun for a statement that denies or opposes another statement
senses.definitionCN: 指否定或反对另一句话的那句陈述
senses.example: His calm reply was a contradiction of everything she had said.
senses.exampleCN: 他平静的回答是对她所说一切的否定。
senses.why: The -tion noun names the second statement itself. In logic it is the proposition that asserts the negation of another.
senses.whyCN: -tion 名词命名第二句话本身。在逻辑中，它就是断言另一命题之否定的那个命题。

senses.title: Contradiction in logic
senses.titleCN: 逻辑矛盾：同时肯定与否
senses.definition: in logic, the relation between a statement and its negation, which cannot both be true
senses.definitionCN: 逻辑中一个命题与其否定之间的关系，两者不能同时为真
senses.example: The proof ends in a contradiction, so the assumption is false.
senses.exampleCN: 证明以矛盾收尾，所以那个假设是假的。
senses.why: Philosophy uses contradiction as a tool: if assuming P leads to P and not-P, then P must be rejected. Two arrows cannot both be the true direction.
senses.whyCN: 哲学把矛盾当作工具：若假设 P 会推出 P 与非 P，则 P 必须被否定。两支箭头不可能同时是正确方向。

senses.title: Contradict the evidence or the record
senses.definition: of a fact or statement, to be contrary to what the evidence or record shows
senses.definitionCN: （事实或陈述）与证据或记录所显示的内容相反
senses.example: His version of events contradicts the phone records.
senses.exampleCN: 他对事件的描述与通话记录相矛盾。
senses.why: Here the second party is not a person but a record. The record 'speaks' too, and the verb treats it as an opposing voice.
senses.whyCN: 这里的第二方不是人，而是一份记录。记录也会“说话”，动词把它当成一个对立的声音。

senses.title: Contradict the trend or expectation
senses.definition: to be contrary to a general pattern, expectation or rule, often surprisingly
senses.definitionCN: 与一般模式、预期或规则相反，常含出人意料之意
senses.example: The results contradict the usual pattern of growth.
senses.exampleCN: 这些结果与通常的增长模式相反。
senses.why: This extension drops the human speaker entirely: any fact can stand opposite a pattern, and the pattern is what is contradicted.
senses.whyCN: 这一延伸完全去掉了人类说话者：任何事实都能站在某个模式对面，而被反驳的是那个模式。

intro.en: Contradict comes from Latin contradicere, in classical Latin two words: contra 'against' + dicere 'to say, speak'. It is literally 'speak against', and its relatives dictation, predict and verdict all keep the 'say' root.
intro.cn: contradict 来自拉丁语 contradicere，在古典拉丁语中是两个词：contra“反对”加 dicere“说、讲”。它字面就是“反着说”，其亲属 dictation、predict、verdict 都保留“说”这个词根。

items.en: Contra dicere meant 'to speak against'. The prefix contra was originally a comparative form meaning 'in comparison with', which hardened into 'against, opposite'.
items.cn: contra dicere 意为“反着说”。前缀 contra 最初是比较级形式，意为“与……相比”，后来固化为“反对、相反”。

items.en: Dicere 'to say, speak' comes from PIE *deik- 'to show, pronounce solemnly'. The same root gives dictate, predict, verdict, diction and index.
items.cn: dicere“说、讲”来自原始印欧语 *deik-“显示、郑重宣告”。同一词根给出 dictate、predict、verdict、diction、index。

items.en: English recorded contradict in the 1570s meaning 'speak against, oppose' — a sense now obsolete.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪 70 年代记录 contradict，意为“反着说、反对”——这一义项现已废弃。

items.en: From the 1580s it meant 'assert the contrary or opposite of', which is the modern core.
items.cn: 自 16 世纪 80 年代起，它意为“断言相反或对立的一面”，这是现代的核心义。

items.en: Two senses appear around 1600: 'deny the words or assertions of' and, of statements, 'be inconsistent with'. The word moves from a person's speech to the relation between propositions.
items.cn: 约 1600 年出现两个义项：“否认某人的话或断言”，以及（就陈述而言）“与……不一致”。这个词从人的言语转向命题之间的关系。

items.en: Modern English keeps person-against-person (contradict a witness) and fact-against-fact (the data contradict the theory). Contradict is the only one of the con- verbs built on 'speak'.
items.cn: 现代英语同时保留“人对人”（contradict a witness）与“事实对事实”（数据与理论相矛盾）。在 con- 系列动词里，contradict 是唯一建在“说”之上的。

note.en: The look-alike group separates the dicere root from two near-spellings; the near-meaning group ranks kinds of opposition from simple denial to logical refutation.
note.cn: 形近组把 dicere 词根与两个近形词分开；近义组按对立程度排列，从简单否认到逻辑反驳。

entries.definition: an agreement, or to shrink. Its root is trahere 'draw', so it means 'draw together', not 'speak against'.
entries.definitionCN: 协议，或收缩。它的词根是 trahere“拉”，所以是“拉到一起”，不是“反着说”。

entries.definition: to break a rule or law. Contra- 'against' + venire 'come' = come against, so it opposes a rule rather than a statement.
entries.definitionCN: 违反规则或法律。contra-“反对”加 venire“来”＝迎面而来，所以它反对的是规则，而不是陈述。

entries.definition: the way words are chosen and pronounced. It is the noun of dicere, the 'saying' side without contra-.
entries.definitionCN: 用词与发音的方式。它是 dicere 的名词，是“说”的一面，没有 contra-。

entries.definition: to state that something is not true. It is the simple negative act; contradict adds the opposing statement or the clash between two claims.
entries.definitionCN: 声称某事不真实。它是简单的否定行为；contradict 还加上“相反的说法”或“两种主张的冲突”。

entries.definition: to be against a plan, person or idea. It is broader and can be silent; contradict must be spoken or written.
entries.definitionCN: 反对计划、人或观念。它范围更广，可以不出声；contradict 必须说出或写出。

entries.definition: to prove a claim false with evidence. It is stronger than contradict, which only asserts the opposite.
entries.definitionCN: 用证据证明某主张为假。它比 contradict 更强，后者只是断言相反。

entries.definition: of facts, interests or statements, to be incompatible. It is the neutral verb for the clash, without the 'speaking' image.
entries.definitionCN: （事实、利益或陈述）互不相容。它是描述冲突的中性动词，没有“说话”的意象。

normalIntro.en: Real pieces only: contra 'against' + dicere 'say', the same-root family predict, dictate, verdict, diction, and the fixed phrase contradict oneself.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实构件：contra“反对”+ dicere“说”，同根词族 predict、dictate、verdict、diction，以及固定搭配 contradict oneself。

normal.en: Contra means 'against' and dicere means 'say'. To contradict is simply to say against.
normal.cn: contra 意为“反对”，dicere 意为“说”。contradict 就是“反着说”。

normal.en: Predict is 'say before', dictate is 'say for writing', and verdict is 'truly said'. All keep the dic- root.
normal.cn: predict 是“提前说”，dictate 是“说给别人写”，verdict 是“如实说出”。它们都保留 dic- 词根。

normal.en: Contradict, contract and contact look alike but rest on three roots: speak against (dicere), draw together (trahere), touch (tangere).
normal.cn: contradict、contract、contact 形似但立足三个词根：反着说（dicere）、拉到一起（trahere）、触碰（tangere）。

normal.en: Contradict oneself is the same opposition turned inward: you are both the speaker and the one spoken against.
normal.cn: contradict oneself 是同一个对立转向内部：你既是说话者，也是被反驳的那个人。

normal.en: Contradictory is the adjective of two arrows; contradiction is the second arrow itself.
normal.cn: contradictory 是两支箭的形容词；contradiction 就是第二支箭本身。

abstract.en: Picture one point with two arrows leaving it in exactly opposite directions. Only one of them can point where the truth is.
abstract.cn: 想象一个点射出两支方向完全相反的箭。只有一支能指向真相所在的方向。

abstract.en: The arrows can be two people, two reports, a claim and a record, or a theory and its data.
abstract.cn: 这两支箭可以是两个人、两份报告、一项主张与一份记录，或一个理论与它的数据。

abstract.en: Because the word means 'speak against', even a silent record 'speaks' when it contradicts a claim; English lends a voice to the evidence.
abstract.cn: 因为这个词本义是“反着说”，所以连沉默的记录在与主张冲突时也“说话”；英语把声音借给了证据。

examples.en: She contradicted the official account of the accident.
examples.cn: 她反驳了官方对事故的说法。

examples.en: The two witnesses contradicted each other.
examples.cn: 两名证人彼此的说法相互矛盾。

examples.en: His actions contradict everything he says about saving money.
examples.cn: 他的行为与他关于省钱的言论完全矛盾。

dict_mnemonic.text: “肯·戳·迪克特”——肯（定）戳（穿）迪克特（dict 说）的话，把它反过来讲 → contradict 反驳、矛盾

root: 源自拉丁语 contra dicere“反着说”，由 contra“反对”+ dicere“说”构成，核心是“把一句话放到另一句话的正对面”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of contradict, all built on two arrows. A person, a rumour, one's own earlier words, a logical proposition, a record, an expectation — each can be placed opposite something that claims to be true.
sensesIntro.cn: contradict 的九个义项都建立在两支箭上。一个人、一则传闻、自己先前的话、一个逻辑命题、一份记录、一种预期——每一个都能被放到某个自称真实之物的对面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two arrows leaving one point in exactly opposite directions.
core.cn: 核心意象：两支箭从同一点射向完全相反的方向。

branches.en: SPEAKING AGAINST: a person denies or opposes what another has said, and the second voice is the answer.
branches.cn: 反着说：一个人否认或反对另一个人所说的话，第二个声音就是回答。

branches.en: FACTS AGAINST FACTS: two reports, or a version against a record — neither has a mouth, yet they clash.
branches.cn: 事实对事实：两份报告，或一种说法对一份记录——它们都没有嘴，却发生了冲突。

branches.en: TURNED INWARD: self-contradiction places both arrows inside one speaker.
branches.cn: 转向内部：自相矛盾把两支箭都放进同一个说话者体内。

branches.en: THE LOGICAL FORM: contradictory marks the relation, contradiction names the opposing statement, and logic uses it as a proof tool.
branches.cn: 逻辑形式：contradictory 标记关系，contradiction 命名那句相反的话，逻辑则把它当作证明工具。

branches.en: AGAINST THE EXPECTATION: a result can contradict the trend, standing out from the pattern everyone expected it to follow.
branches.cn: 与预期相反：一个结果可以与趋势相违，脱离众人预期它应遵循的模式。

intro.en: Contradict is contra- + dict- + -Ø. English adds -ion, -ory, -or and -able, and the broader dic- family keeps the 'say' meaning.
intro.cn: contradict 是 contra- + dict- + -Ø。英语加 -ion、-ory、-or、-able，而更广的 dic- 词族保留“说”的意义。

latinIntro.en: The Latin dicere family is very large: dicere, dictus 'said', contradictio, dictio 'a saying', praedicere 'foretell', and verdictum 'truly said'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 dicere 词族非常庞大：dicere、dictus“说过的”、contradictio、dictio“说法”、praedicere“预言”、verdictum“如实说出”。

items.meaning: to speak against; to be inconsistent with
a statement that opposes another; the state of clashing
items.meaningCN: 矛盾；反驳；矛盾之处（-ion 构成名词）
items.example: There is a contradiction between the two clauses.
items.exampleCN: 两个条款之间存在矛盾。

items.meaning: mutually opposed; unable to be true together
items.meaningCN: 相互矛盾的（-ory 构成形容词）
items.exampleCN: 证人给出了相互矛盾的回答。

items.meaning: a person who contradicts or opposes
items.example: His main contradictor was the junior minister.
items.exampleCN: 他主要的反驳者是那位副部长。

items.meaning: able to be contradicted or denied
items.meaningCN: 可被反驳的（-able 表可能）
items.example: That claim is not easily contradictable.
items.exampleCN: 那个主张不容易被反驳。

items.meaning: the state of contradicting one's own words
to say what will happen before it happens
items.meaningCN: 预测；预言（pre- 表之前，同一词根）
items.example: Scientists predict a rise in sea level.
items.exampleCN: 科学家预测海平面会上升。

items.meaning: to say words for someone to write; to give orders
items.example: She dictated the letter to her assistant.
items.exampleCN: 她向助理口述了这封信。

items.meaning: the decision a jury gives, literally 'truly said'
items.meaningCN: 裁决（字面“如实说出”，同一词根）
items.example: The jury reached a verdict at noon.
items.exampleCN: 陪审团中午作出了裁决。

items.meaning: the choice and use of words; pronunciation
items.example: The poem's diction is deliberately old-fashioned.
items.exampleCN: 这首诗的措辞刻意古旧。

definition_zh: 赎罪；弥补；补偿
definition_en: to make amends for a wrong or injury
core_image: 把打翻的油一瓶瓶补回去，直到秤平为止
scene: 老人每周末都去河岸捡垃圾，替年轻时倾倒废料的工厂赎一份迟到的债。 He worked by the river for years to atone for his old mistakes.
sceneCN: 这里 atone 是「赎罪、弥补」（第 1 个义项：为过错作出补偿）；句意为他在河边劳作多年以弥补从前的过错。

pos.zh: 赎罪；弥补（常与 for 连用）

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「赎罪；补偿」
由动词加人后缀构成，义为「赎罪者」

senses.title: To make amends for wrongdoing
senses.definition: to do something good as payment for a wrong
senses.definitionCN: 以善行偿还所犯的过错
senses.example: She atoned for the betrayal with years of loyal service.
senses.exampleCN: 她以多年的忠诚服务弥补那次背叛。
senses.why: At one means set at one: wrong splits people, amends reunite them.
senses.whyCN: at one 意为「合而为一」：过错使人分裂，弥补使人重归于好。

senses.title: To pay a penalty or price
senses.definition: to suffer or pay in return for harm done
senses.definitionCN: 为造成的伤害承受或付出代价
senses.example: The whole town atoned for one man's greed.
senses.exampleCN: 全城为一个人的贪婪付出代价。
senses.why: Restoring oneness requires balancing the scales again.
senses.whyCN: 恢复「合一」需要把失衡的天平重新摆平。

intro.en: Atone began as the phrase at one, set at one, a Middle English rendering of religious reconciliation.
intro.cn: atone 始于短语 at one（使合而为一），是中古英语对宗教性和解的表达。

items.en: An meant one; at an meant in union.
items.cn: 古英语 an 意为一；at an 意为合于一体。

items.en: At one described reconciling parties in dispute.
items.cn: 中古英语 at one 描述使争执双方和解。

items.en: The phrase fused into the verb atone, tied to theology.
items.cn: 十六世纪短语凝缩为动词 atone，与神学紧密相连。

items.en: Atonement named Christ's reconciling sacrifice.
items.cn: atonement 指基督的和解性献祭。

items.en: Secular uses now cover any making of amends.
items.cn: 如今世俗用法泛指一切补偿过失之举。

note.en: Atone is at one: the wrong tore, the payment sews.
note.cn: atone 即 at one：过错撕裂，补偿缝合。

entries.definition: the act or price of atoning
entries.definitionCN: 赎罪；补偿（同根名词）

entries.definition: music without a key, different root
entries.definitionCN: 无调性的（形近，词源不同）

entries.definition: to adjust in harmony, different root
entries.definitionCN: 使协调（形近，词源不同）

entries.definition: the original phrase at peace together
entries.definitionCN: 合而为一（来源短语）

entries.definition: to atone, in formal religious register
entries.definitionCN: 赎罪（正式近义词）

entries.definition: to extinguish guilt by suffering or payment
entries.definitionCN: 赎罪；抵偿

entries.definition: to buy back or make up for
entries.definitionCN: 赎回；弥补

entries.definition: to feel regret and resolve to change
entries.definitionCN: 悔悟

entries.definition: to pay back for loss or harm
entries.definitionCN: 补偿；赔偿

entries.definition: to compensate for injury
entries.definitionCN: 赔罪；弥补

normalIntro.en: Read atone as at-one: bring the broken sides back to one.
normalIntro.cn: 把 atone 读成 at-one：把破裂的双方重新合为一体。

normal.en: comes from the phrase at one.
normal.cn: 源自短语 at one。

normal.en: usually takes for + the wrong.
normal.cn: 通常接 for 加过错。

normal.en: atonement is the theological noun.
normal.cn: atonement 是神学名词。

normal.en: expiate is the formal Latin cousin.
normal.cn: expiate 是正式的拉丁表亲。

normal.en: atonal only looks related.
normal.cn: atonal 只是形似而已。

abstract.en: Picture two torn halves of a letter pressed together.
abstract.cn: 想象撕成两半的信被重新拼合。

abstract.en: See a scale tipping back to level.
abstract.cn: 看见倾斜的天平回到水平。

abstract.en: Feel a handshake ending a long feud.
abstract.cn: 体会一场宿怨以握手作结。

examples.en: He fasted to atone for his lies.
examples.cn: 他斋戒以赎谎言之过。

examples.en: Atoning took the rest of her life.
examples.cn: 赎罪耗尽了她的余生。

examples.en: No gift can atone for broken trust.
examples.cn: 任何礼物都无法弥补破裂的信任。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额痛」——额痛悔前非，痛而改过弥补，即 atone。

root: 古英语 an（一）→ 中古英语短语 at one（使合而为一）→ 十六世纪凝缩为动词 atone（赎罪；弥补）。

sensesIntro.en: Being set at one grows into both moral repayment and paying the price.
sensesIntro.cn: 「合而为一」既化作道德上的偿还，也化作付出代价。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: torn halves sewn back into one
core.cn: 核心意象：撕裂的两半重新缝为一体

branches.en: moral amends for wrong
branches.cn: 为过错作道德弥补

branches.en: suffering the price
branches.cn: 承受代价

branches.en: the at-one image at work
branches.cn: 「合一」意象的两种落点

branches.en: reconciling divided parties
branches.cn: 使分裂各方和解

branches.en: balancing the scales
branches.cn: 摆平失衡的天平

intro.en: Atone is unity turned moral: one split, then one again.
intro.cn: atone 是道德化的「一」：先分裂，后复合。

latinIntro.en: Uniquely English: no Latin root, only the native phrase at one.
latinIntro.cn: 独特的英语词：没有拉丁词根，只有本土短语 at one。

derivatives.zh: 赎罪；补偿

definition_zh: 热液喷口；海底热泉（热流体从海底裂隙喷出的开口）
definition_en: an opening on the seafloor where hot mineral-rich fluid discharges into cold seawater
core_image: 海底裂开一道缝，黑色的热水柱夹着矿物颗粒往上冲，遇冷立刻沉下一圈烟尘
scene: 深潜器悬停在裂隙上方，滚烫的黑色水流夹着矿物颗粒涌出。 A hydrothermal vent pours mineral-rich water onto the seafloor.
sceneCN: 这里 hydrothermal vent 指「海底热流体喷出的开口」（第 1 个义项：作为地点的喷口本身）；句意为一个热液喷口把富含矿物的热水倾泻到海底。

pos.zh: 热液喷口；海底热泉（可数，复数 hydrothermal vents）

derivatives.zh: vent（拉丁 ventus「风」经「出风口」义而来）→ 开口、排气口；排放
hydro-（希腊「水」）+ thermal（希腊「热」）→ 热液的：热水参与的
black（黑）+ smoker（冒烟者）→ 喷出黑色矿物颗粒的高温喷口：黑烟囱
cold（冷）+ seep（渗漏）→ 低温流体缓慢渗出的海底地点：冷泉（与热液喷口相对）

senses.title: The opening itself
senses.titleCN: 喷口本体：热流体喷出的海底开口
senses.definition: the seafloor opening through which hot fluid discharges
senses.definitionCN: 热流体由此排出的海底开口
senses.example: A hydrothermal vent pours mineral-rich water onto the seafloor.
senses.exampleCN: 一个热液喷口把富含矿物的热水倾泻到海底。
senses.why: vent names an opening, and hydrothermal names the fluid, so the phrase is literally a hot-water outlet.
senses.whyCN: vent 命名开口，hydrothermal 命名流体，短语字面就是「热水的出口」。

senses.title: The rising plume
senses.titleCN: 上升的羽流：喷出的热水柱
senses.definition: the cloud of hot particle-laden water rising from the opening
senses.definitionCN: 从开口上升的、夹带颗粒的热水云
senses.example: A dark plume rose from the hydrothermal vent.
senses.exampleCN: 一股深色羽流从热液喷口升起。
senses.why: what the vent emits is continuous with the vent, so the word is used for the plume as well as the hole.
senses.whyCN: 喷口喷出的东西与喷口连成一体，因此这个词也用来指羽流而不只指洞口。

senses.title: The chimney it builds
senses.definition: the mineral structure built up around the opening by precipitated solids
senses.definitionCN: 沉淀物在开口周围堆成的矿物构造
senses.example: The hydrothermal vent grew a chimney two metres tall.
senses.exampleCN: 这个热液喷口长出一座两米高的烟囱。
senses.why: dissolved minerals settle where hot fluid meets cold seawater, so the opening slowly builds its own tower.
senses.whyCN: 溶解矿物在热流体与冷海水相遇处沉淀，于是开口慢慢筑起自己的塔。

senses.title: A chemosynthetic community
senses.definition: the assemblage of organisms that live on chemical energy at a vent
senses.definitionCN: 依靠化学能在喷口处生活的生物集合
senses.example: Tube worms crowd around the hydrothermal vent.
senses.exampleCN: 管虫密密地围着这个热液喷口。
senses.why: the vent supplies sulphides instead of sunlight, so the word also names the unique community it feeds.
senses.whyCN: 喷口提供的是硫化物而非阳光，因此这个词也命名它供养的独特群落。

senses.title: An exit of a circulation system
senses.definition: the discharge point of a larger hydrothermal circulation
senses.definitionCN: 更大规模热液循环的排出点
senses.example: Each hydrothermal vent marks where the circuit reaches the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 每个热液喷口都标出循环回到海面处。
senses.why: in a circuit, the vent is the outlet end, so the word describes a position in a system as well as a hole.
senses.whyCN: 在一个循环里，喷口是出口端，因此这个词既描述洞口，也描述系统中的一个位置。

senses.title: An ancient vent and its ore
senses.titleCN: 古喷口与块状硫化物矿
senses.definition: a former vent preserved in rock as a massive sulphide deposit
senses.definitionCN: 保存在岩石中、成为块状硫化物矿床的旧喷口
senses.example: Miners worked an ancient hydrothermal vent for copper.
senses.exampleCN: 矿工开采一处古热液喷口以获取铜。
senses.why: when the seafloor is lifted onto land, the vent and its chimney become an ore body.
senses.whyCN: 当海底被抬升到陆地上，喷口与烟囱就变成了矿体。

senses.title: A target for water-column survey
senses.definition: a feature located by detecting its plume in the water column
senses.definitionCN: 通过探测水柱中的羽流而定位的对象
senses.example: The ship found a hydrothermal vent by tracing a chemical anomaly.
senses.exampleCN: 这艘船通过追踪化学异常找到了一处热液喷口。
senses.why: the vent is hidden below, but its plume spreads above, so survey work treats the plume as the vent's signature.
senses.whyCN: 喷口藏在下面，羽流却扩散在上面，因此探测工作把羽流当作喷口的签名。

senses.title: An analogue on icy moons
senses.definition: a hypothetical seafloor vent beneath the ice of another world
senses.definitionCN: 其他天体冰层之下假想的海底喷口
senses.example: A hydrothermal vent under that ice could support life.
senses.exampleCN: 那片冰下的热液喷口可能支持生命。
senses.why: the conditions are defined by physics rather than by Earth, so planetary science reuses the term for alien oceans.
senses.whyCN: 这些条件由物理而非地球决定，因此行星科学把这个词用于外星海洋。

intro.en: Hydrothermal vent joins a Greek-rooted adjective to an English noun of Latin origin. Vent goes back through Old French to Latin ventus 'wind', whose sense shifted from moving air to the hole it blows through. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: hydrothermal vent 把希腊词根的形容词接在一个拉丁语源的英语名词上。vent 经古法语上溯拉丁 ventus「风」，词义从流动的空气转为它吹过的孔洞。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ventus meant 'wind'; Old French vent carried both 'wind' and 'opening for air', and English borrowed the latter.
items.cn: ventus 意为「风」；古法语 vent 兼有「风」与「通气口」两义，英语借入的是后者。

items.en: Hydro- and thermal come from Greek hydor 'water' and therme 'heat', joined in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: hydro- 与 thermal 来自希腊 hydor「水」与 therme「热」，于十九世纪合成。

items.en: The phrase hydrothermal vent was assembled in the late twentieth century once seafloor hot springs were directly observed.
items.cn: 海底热泉被直接观测到之后，hydrothermal vent 这一短语才在二十世纪后期组合起来。

items.en: Sailors' slang for a smoky funnel was borrowed for the dark chimneys, producing the informal synonym black smoker.
items.cn: 水手把冒烟的烟囱称作黑烟囱，这一俚语被借来形容深色喷口，产生了非正式同义词 black smoker。

items.en: The discovery of vent communities in 1977 made the phrase a biological term as well as a geological one.
items.cn: 一九七七年喷口生物群落的发现，使这个短语同时成为生物学术语。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the two elements are secure, but the earliest use of the exact phrase is not fixed in reference works.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代存疑）：两个成分都可靠，但这一确切短语的最早使用在各类工具书中并无定论。

note.en: Group one holds the vent types and related discharge features that are routinely confused; group two holds the general words for an opening or a spring.
note.cn: 第一组是常被混淆的喷口类型与相关排放地貌；第二组是泛指开口或泉的词语。

entries.definition: A very hot vent whose fluid precipitates dark metal sulphides; it is a kind of hydrothermal vent, not a separate thing.
entries.definitionCN: 流体沉淀出深色金属硫化物的极热喷口；它是热液喷口的一种，并非另类事物。

entries.definition: A cooler vent whose fluid precipitates pale silica and barytes rather than dark sulphides.
entries.definitionCN: 温度较低的喷口，流体沉淀浅色硅质与重晶石，而非深色硫化物。

entries.definition: A seafloor seep of cold, often methane-rich fluid; it lacks the high temperature that defines a hydrothermal vent.
entries.definitionCN: 低温且常富含甲烷的海底渗漏；缺少定义热液喷口所需的高温。

entries.definition: A cluster of vents and deposits in one area; a single opening is a vent, not a field.
entries.definitionCN: 同一区域的一组喷口与沉积；单个开口是喷口，不是热液场。

entries.definition: Any opening for air, gas or liquid; alone it says nothing about temperature or the sea.
entries.definitionCN: 任何供气、气或液体通过的开口；单用时不涉及温度或海洋。

entries.definition: A natural flow of water from the ground; it is usually on land and usually cool.
entries.definitionCN: 水从地下自然流出；通常在陆上，通常温度不高。

entries.definition: A slow, spreading flow through pores or small cracks; it stresses gradual leakage, not forceful discharge.
entries.definitionCN: 经孔隙或小裂缝缓慢扩散的流动；强调渐渗，而非猛烈喷出。

entries.definition: The rising cloud carried away from the opening; it is the product of a vent, not the vent itself.
entries.definitionCN: 从开口被带走的上升云团；它是喷口的产物，不是喷口本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real compounds, real vent types and real physical steps, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的复合词、真实的喷口类型与真实的物理步骤，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: hydrothermal is water plus heat; vent is an opening: the phrase is a hot-water opening.
normal.cn: hydrothermal 是水加热，vent 是开口：这个短语就是「热水的开口」。

normal.en: Dark smoke means dark ore: black smokers precipitate sulphides, white smokers precipitate silica.
normal.cn: 深色的烟意味着深色的矿：黑烟囱沉淀硫化物，白烟囱沉淀硅质。

normal.en: A vent is hot, a seep is cold: the two words divide seafloor discharge by temperature.
normal.cn: 喷口是热的，渗漏是冷的：两个词按温度划分海底排放。

normal.en: The chimney is made by the vent itself, layer by layer, where hot meets cold.
normal.cn: 烟囱是喷口自己在热水遇冷处一层层造出来的。

normal.en: No sunlight, no problem: the community runs on sulphides through chemosynthesis.
normal.cn: 没有阳光也没关系：这个群落靠硫化物进行化能合成。

abstract.en: A vent is a wound in the seafloor that keeps talking.
abstract.cn: 喷口是海底的一道伤口，一直在说话。

abstract.en: It is a chimney with no fire below, only stone and hot water arguing.
abstract.cn: 它是一座下面没有火的烟囱，只有石头与热水在争论。

abstract.en: Life here begins with chemistry instead of dawn.
abstract.cn: 这里的生命以化学开始，而不是以黎明开始。

examples.en: The submersible filmed a hydrothermal vent at two thousand metres.
examples.cn: 深潜器在两千公尺处拍摄到一处热液喷口。

examples.en: Each hydrothermal vent hosts its own community of worms and clams.
examples.cn: 每个热液喷口都养育着自己的一套蠕虫与蛤类群落。

examples.en: The hydrothermal vent built a chimney of metal sulphides.
examples.cn: 这个热液喷口用金属硫化物筑起一座烟囱。

dict_mnemonic.text: hydrothermal（热液的）+ vent（出口）＝热液喷口；热水从海底裂缝冲出，遇冷沉淀成烟囱，养活靠化学能的生命。

root: hydrothermal（希腊 hydor「水」+ therme「热」）+ vent（拉丁 ventus「风」，义转为出风口）；短语为二十世纪后期地质学所立。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one opening: the hole, the plume, the chimney, the community it feeds, its place in a circuit, its fossil ore, its plume as a survey signature, and its analogue on icy moons.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个开口展开：洞口、羽流、烟囱、它供养的群落、它在循环中的位置、它化成的矿、作为探测信号的羽流，以及冰卫星上的类比。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crack in the seafloor sending a hot dark jet into cold water.
core.cn: 核心意象：海底一道裂缝，把滚烫的深色水柱送进冷水里。

branches.en: HOLE AND JET: the opening, then what comes out of it.
branches.cn: 洞口与射流：先是开口，再是从中出来的东西。

branches.en: BUILT TOWER: precipitation turns the opening into a structure.
branches.cn: 堆成的塔：沉淀把开口变成构造。

branches.en: COMMUNITY AND CIRCUIT: what lives there, and where the outlet sits in the loop.
branches.cn: 群落与循环：那里住着什么，以及出口在环流中的位置。

branches.en: ORE AND SIGNATURE: a fossil vent becomes a mine, a plume becomes a clue.
branches.cn: 矿与信号：化石喷口变成矿，羽流变成线索。

branches.en: ALIEN ANALOGUE: the same opening imagined under another world's ice.
branches.cn: 外星类比：同一个开口被想象在另一个天体的冰下。

intro.en: Hydrothermal vent combines a Greek-rooted adjective with a short English noun, so the phrase is morphologically transparent at both ends.
intro.cn: hydrothermal vent 把希腊词根的形容词与一个简短英语名词组合，短语两端在构词上都透明。

latinIntro.en: Hydrothermal contributes no Latin entry; vent does, through Latin ventus 'wind'. The two halves come from different language families.
latinIntro.cn: hydrothermal 不提供拉丁条目；vent 则经拉丁 ventus「风」提供。两半来自不同语系。

items.exampleCN: hydro- 是形容词 hydrothermal 的开头。
therme 提供 thermal 与 thermometer。

items.structure: ventus, venti (Latin noun, masculine, fourth declension)
items.example: Ventus gave French vent and English vent.
items.exampleCN: ventus 给出法语 vent 与英语 vent。

items.meaning: an opening for air or fluid
items.meaningCN: 供空气或流体通过的开口
items.exampleCN: 蒸汽从一个排气口逸出。

items.meaning: relating to hot water in rock

items.exampleCN: 这个热液喷口排出硫化物。

items.meaning: a hot vent with dark precipitate
items.meaningCN: 沉淀物呈深色的高温喷口
items.example: The black smoker chimney stood three metres high.

items.meaning: a cooler vent with pale precipitate
items.meaningCN: 沉淀物呈浅色的较低温喷口
items.example: A white smoker stood beside the black one.
items.exampleCN: 一座白烟囱立在黑烟囱旁边。

items.example: Methane supports life at the cold seep.
items.exampleCN: 甲烷在冷泉处供养生命。

items.example: The plume drifted west from the vent.

definition_zh: 使多样化；分散投资；开展多元化业务
definition_en: to make something more varied, or to spread money or activity across different areas
core_image: 一只手把同一种东西撒向好几块不同的田地
scene: 一家只卖一种农产品的家族企业决定把业务扩展到食品加工与乡村旅店。 The family firm decided to diversify into food processing and rural tourism.
sceneCN: 这里指「把业务扩展到新的领域」，对应第 3 个义项：企业进入与原业务不同的产品线；句意为这家家族企业决定向食品加工与乡村旅游业多元化。画面要点：农田、加工车间、旅店招牌。

pos.zh: 使多样化；分散（投资）；开展多元化业务；增加（作物、来源等的）种类

derivatives.zh: 多样化；分散投资
多元化的；分散的
多样性
多样的
分散风险者；多元化经营者

senses.title: To make more varied
senses.definition: to introduce a wider range of types into something
senses.definitionCN: 把更广泛的类型引入某事物
senses.example: The school diversified its reading list.
senses.exampleCN: 学校使阅读书单更加多样。
senses.why: The verb is the general action behind the noun: one line of things is turned into several lines.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词是名词背后的一般动作：一条线上的一类东西被转成好几条线。

senses.title: To spread investments
senses.definition: to put money into several assets instead of one
senses.definitionCN: 把钱投入多项资产而不是只投一项
senses.example: Retirees should diversify before markets turn.
senses.exampleCN: 退休者应在市场转向之前先分散投资。
senses.why: Finance turns the general act into risk management: many assets mean many chances instead of one.
senses.whyCN: 金融把这个一般动作变成风险管理：多项资产意味着多个机会而不是一个。

senses.title: To enter new lines of business
senses.definition: for a company, to expand into products or services beyond its original line
senses.definitionCN: 企业扩展到原业务之外的产品或服务
senses.example: The chain diversified into coffee shops.
senses.exampleCN: 这家连锁企业扩展到咖啡店业务。
senses.why: A firm that adds a second line is literally adding kinds to its basket of revenue.
senses.whyCN: 增添第二条业务线的公司，实际上是在其收入篮子里加上新的种类。

senses.title: To vary products or markets
senses.definition: to change the mix of goods sold or the markets served
senses.definitionCN: 改变所售商品或所服务市场的组合
senses.example: The exporter diversified its markets across Asia.
senses.exampleCN: 这家出口商在亚洲各地分散市场。
senses.why: Here the added kinds are goods and destinations, so the verb shifts from entering a line to changing the mix.
senses.whyCN: 这里增添的种类是商品与目的地，动词因此从「进入一条线」转为「改变组合」。

senses.title: To broaden an economy
senses.definition: to reduce a region's dependence on one industry
senses.definitionCN: 降低一个地区对单一产业的依赖
senses.example: The province diversified away from timber.
senses.exampleCN: 该省从木材业转向多元化。
senses.why: The verb scales a company strategy up to a whole region: one industry is replaced by several.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词把企业策略放大到整个地区：一个产业被好几个产业取代。

senses.title: To increase genetic variety
senses.definition: to widen the range of genes in a population or crop
senses.definitionCN: 扩大种群或作物的基因范围
senses.example: Plant breeders diversify wheat to resist disease.
senses.exampleCN: 育种者使小麦多样化以抗病。
senses.why: Breeding uses the same act without markets: more kinds in the gene pool mean fewer total failures.
senses.whyCN: 育种在没有市场的情况下使用同一动作：基因库里种类更多，整体失败就更少。

senses.title: To expand one's range of activity
senses.definition: for a person or group, to take on new kinds of work or interest
senses.definitionCN: 个人或团体承担新的工作或兴趣种类
senses.example: She diversified her practice to include family law.
senses.exampleCN: 她扩展业务范围，纳入了家庭法。
senses.why: A career or practice can be a portfolio of activities, so the verb applies to a person's bundle of work.
senses.whyCN: 职业或业务可以是一组活动，因此这个动词也能用于一个人的工作束。

senses.title: To grow several crops
senses.definition: to replace a single crop with several on the same farm
senses.definitionCN: 在同一农场上以多种作物取代单一作物
senses.example: The cooperative diversified into fruit and nuts.
senses.exampleCN: 合作社多样化种植水果与坚果。
senses.why: The field is the simplest basket: several crops spread the risk of weather and price.
senses.whyCN: 田地是最简单的篮子：几种作物分散天气与价格风险。

senses.title: To change the mix of sources
senses.definition: to add different sources of supply or energy
senses.definitionCN: 增加不同的供应或能源来源
senses.example: The grid diversified into wind and solar power.
senses.exampleCN: 电网向风能与太阳能多元化。
senses.why: Sources are supplies, so the same verb says: do not depend on one well, one pipe or one country.
senses.whyCN: 来源就是供应，所以同一个动词表达：不要只依赖一口井、一条管道或一个国家。

intro.en: Diversify is an English verb formed from Latin diversus 'turned apart' and facere 'to make'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: diversify 是英语动词，由拉丁语 diversus「转向别处」与 facere「制造」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn; its participle supplied the idea of being turned in another direction.
items.cn: vertere 意为转动；它的分词形式提供了「被转向另一方向」的意思。

items.en: Diversus meant turned apart or various, the direct ancestor of diverse and diversity.
items.cn: diversus 意为被转开或多样的，是 diverse 与 diversity 的直接祖先。

items.en: Diversificare joined that adjective with facere 'to make' to mean to make different or varied.
items.cn: diversificare 把这个形容词与 facere「制造」结合，意为使不同、使多样。

items.en: French used the verb in ordinary speech, and English borrowed it in the seventeenth century as diversify.
items.cn: 法语在日常语言中使用这个动词，英语在十七世纪以 diversify 的形式借入。

items.en: Modern finance applied the verb to holdings and modern industry applied it to products, markets and regions.
items.cn: 现代金融把这个动词用于持有资产，现代产业则把它用于产品、市场与地区。

note.en: The first group is built on the same turning root and is often confused with it; the second group contains verbs of widening or varying.
note.cn: 第一组建立在同一个「转」的词根上，常被混淆；第二组是表示扩大或变化的动词。

entries.definition: A change of route or an entertainment; it turns one thing away rather than adding kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 改道或消遣；它把一样东西转开，而不是增加种类。

entries.definition: The state of being varied; it is the result, while diversify is the action that creates it.
entries.definitionCN: 多样的状态；它是结果，而 diversify 是创造它的动作。

entries.definition: Of many different kinds; it describes a set, not the process of changing it.
entries.definitionCN: 许多不同种类的；它描述一个集合，而不是改变它的过程。

entries.definition: To change the course of something; it does not mean to multiply its kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 改变某物的方向；不表示增加其种类。

entries.definition: To make or become different over time; vary stresses change, diversify stresses adding kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 使或变得不同；vary 强调变化，diversify 强调增加种类。

entries.definition: To make wider in scope; it stresses extent rather than the number of kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 使范围更宽；强调广度而非种类的数量。

entries.definition: To grow in size or reach; expansion may stay within one business, while diversification must cross boundaries.
entries.definitionCN: 在规模或范围上增长；扩张可以在同一业务内，而多元化必须跨界。

entries.definition: To distribute over an area; in finance it describes the physical result of diversifying.
entries.definitionCN: 分布到一片区域；在金融中描述分散化的实际结果。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin pieces, real compounds and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁成分、真实复合词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: The word is make plus turned apart: to diversify is to make things head in different directions.
normal.cn: 这个词是「制造」加「转向别处」：多元化就是让事物朝不同方向走。

normal.en: Money diversifies into assets, a firm into products, a region into industries, a farm into crops.
normal.cn: 资金分散到资产，企业扩展到产品，地区扩展到产业，农场扩展到作物。

normal.en: The fixed phrase diversify into marks the new field being entered.
normal.cn: 表示「扩展到某一领域」的固定说法标出正在进入的新领域。

normal.en: Diversify away from marks the old dependence being reduced.
normal.cn: 表示「从某一领域转向别处」的说法标出正在减少的旧依赖。

normal.en: The noun diversification and the adjective diversified come from this verb, not the other way round.
normal.cn: 名词 diversification 与形容词 diversified 都从这个动词而来，而不是反过来。

abstract.en: Picture one hand scattering the same seed over several fields, so no single storm can take the whole harvest.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把同一种种子撒向好几块田，任何一场风暴都拿不走全部收成。

abstract.en: Picture a single stream split into several channels, each able to supply water if another dries.
abstract.cn: 想象一条水流分成几道渠，任何一条干了，其余仍能供水。

abstract.en: Picture a person's work splitting into several skills, so one closed door does not end the career.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人的工作分成几项技能，一扇门关上并不终结整个职业。

examples.en: Farmers were advised to diversify their crops after the drought.
examples.cn: 干旱之后，农民被建议使作物多样化。

examples.en: The fund diversifies across regions and industries.
examples.cn: 该基金在地域与行业上分散投资。

examples.en: The city hopes to diversify away from tourism.
examples.cn: 这座城市希望摆脱对旅游业的依赖而走向多元化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「使分成许多样」——把投资、产品、作物都分成好几路 → 多元化

root: 由拉丁语 diversus「转向别处的、多样的」与 facere「制造」构成，经法语进入英语；核心动作是使一类事物变成多类。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses apply one act to different objects: reading lists, portfolios, business lines, markets, regional economies, genes, careers, crops and energy sources.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项把同一个动作用到不同对象上：书单、投资组合、业务线、市场、地区经济、基因、职业、作物与能源来源。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand scattering the same seed across several fields.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把同一种种子撒向好几块田。

branches.en: GENERAL ACTION: a single range is deliberately widened into several kinds.
branches.cn: 一般动作：单一范围被有意拓宽成好几种。

branches.en: FINANCIAL ACTION: money is placed in many assets instead of one.
branches.cn: 金融动作：资金被放进多项资产而不是只有一项。

branches.en: NEW WORK: a firm adds business lines and a person adds kinds of practice.
branches.cn: 新工作：公司增添业务线，个人增添业务种类。

branches.en: WIDENING MIX: products, regional industries and supply sources are all re-mixed.
branches.cn: 拓宽组合：产品、地区产业与供应来源都被重新调配。

branches.en: NATURAL AND FIELD VARIETY: genes and crops are varied so one disease cannot take everything.
branches.cn: 自然与田地的多样：基因与作物被多样化，使一种病害拿不走全部。

intro.en: Diversify is a transparent Latin-derived verb: a turning root, a making suffix, and a family of related nouns and adjectives.
intro.cn: diversify 是一个结构清楚的拉丁来源动词：一个「转」的词根、一个「制造」的后缀，以及一族相关名词与形容词。

latinIntro.en: The root vertere 'to turn' also builds convert, reverse and versatile; diversus adds the sense of turning apart.
latinIntro.cn: 词根表示「转」，也构成 convert、reverse 与 versatile；diversus 增添「转向别处」的意思。

items.example: The root appears in reverse and version.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根出现在反转与版本等词里。

items.example: To clarify is to make clear.

items.meaning: made varied, or having entered new lines
items.meaningCN: 已多样化的，或已进入新业务线的
items.example: The economy is more diversified now.

items.exampleCN: 他们正在使供应商多样化。
他们服务于一个多元市场。

items.meaning: a person or thing that diversifies
items.meaningCN: 进行多样化的人或事物
items.exampleCN: 黄金充当一种分散工具。

latinEntries.meaning: able to turn to many uses

derivatives.zh: 多样化；分散投资
多元化的；分散的
多样性
多样的
分散风险者；多元化经营者

definition_zh: 恋情；（尤指秘密的）风流韵事
definition_en: a love affair, especially a secret or illicit one
core_image: 深夜递出的一封信：藏在披风下的恋情
scene: 宫廷里人人低声议论着王妃与乐师的传闻。 The queen's secret amour was the talk of the entire court.
sceneCN: 这里的 amour 是「秘密恋情」（第 1 个义项：隐秘的恋爱关系）；句意是王后的秘密恋情成为整个宫廷的谈资。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「含情脉脉的；多情的」
amorous 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「多情；柔情」
同根词，义为「情人；尤指不正当的恋人」

senses.title: A secret or illicit love affair
senses.titleCN: 秘密恋情：隐秘或越界的恋爱关系
senses.definition: a romantic relationship kept hidden, often because it is improper
senses.definitionCN: 因不合礼俗而隐藏的恋爱关系
senses.example: The novel recounts a dangerous amour in wartime Paris.
senses.exampleCN: 小说讲述了战时巴黎一段危险的恋情。
senses.why: From Latin amor, love: when love must hide, English reaches for the French word.
senses.whyCN: 源自拉丁语 amor「爱」：当爱必须隐藏时，英语便借用法语词。

senses.title: A love affair in general, literary register
senses.titleCN: 恋情泛称：文学语域的爱恋
senses.definition: a romantic attachment, without necessarily any secrecy, in elevated style
senses.definitionCN: 书卷语域中的浪漫恋情，不必然隐秘
senses.example: His early amours filled three volumes of letters.
senses.exampleCN: 他早年的恋情感事写满了三卷书信。
senses.why: The word keeps its French elegance, so writers use it for romance as a subject.
senses.whyCN: 这个词保留了法语的雅致，作家便用它来谈论作为主题的爱情。

senses.title: Courtly love in chivalric tradition
senses.titleCN: 骑士之爱：典雅爱情传统
senses.definition: the idealized, ritualized love of medieval courtly literature
senses.definitionCN: 中世纪骑士文学中理想化、仪式化的爱情
senses.example: The knight pledged service to his lady in the fashion of courtly amour.
senses.exampleCN: 骑士以典雅爱情的方式向贵妇人宣誓效忠。
senses.why: Medieval romance codified love into duties; the borrowed word carries that ritual air.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪骑士文学把爱情规则化，这个借词因此带有仪式感。

senses.title: The beloved person
senses.definition: a person with whom one has a love affair; a lover
senses.definitionCN: 恋爱关系的对象；爱人
senses.example: He wrote poem after poem to his amour.
senses.exampleCN: 他为恋人写了一首又一首诗。
senses.why: The feeling word slides onto the person who causes it.
senses.whyCN: 指情感的词会滑向引发情感的人。

intro.en: Amour is the French form of Latin amor, love, borrowed into English with a hint of secrecy.
intro.cn: amour 是拉丁语 amor（爱）的法语形式，借入英语后带上一丝隐秘色彩。

items.en: Root *am-, to love.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *am-「爱」。

items.en: amor, love; the root verb is amare.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amor「爱」，动词原形为 amare。

items.en: amour, both the feeling of love and a love affair.
items.cn: 古法语 amour，既指爱之情感，也指一段恋情。

items.en: English borrows amour, at first simply meaning love.
items.cn: 十三世纪中世纪英语借入 amour，最初只表示「爱」。

items.en: The sense narrows to love affairs, often scandalous ones.
items.cn: 十六、十七世纪词义收窄为恋情，且常带绯闻色彩。

items.en: Now a literary word for a romantic or secret affair.
items.cn: 如今是表示浪漫或隐秘恋情的文学用语。

note.en: Tell amour apart from its love-root relatives and from rival affair words.
note.cn: 把 amour 与「爱」词根的亲属词区分开，并与其他「风流韵事」用词对比。

entries.definition: adjective showing love; amour is the affair itself.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词「多情的」；amour 是恋情本身，同根易混。

entries.definition: the person in an illicit affair; amour is the relationship, paramour the lover.
entries.definitionCN: 不正当的恋人；amour 指关系，paramour 指人，同根注意分工。

entries.definition: one who loves an activity unpaid; same root am-, different branch.
entries.definitionCN: 业余爱好者；同属 am- 词根但语义分支不同，勿混。

entries.definition: a romantic involvement, often secret; the plain modern word.
entries.definitionCN: 婚外情、恋情；现代最常用的普通说法。

entries.definition: a secret romantic link, French loanword like amour.
entries.definitionCN: 私情；与 amour 同为法语借词。

entries.definition: a secret meeting between lovers.
entries.definitionCN: 幽会；强调情人秘密会面。

normalIntro.en: Hear the love inside amour directly.
normalIntro.cn: 直接听出 amour 里的「爱」。

normal.en: amour is literally French for love.
normal.cn: amour 就是法语「爱」这个词本身。

normal.en: Family: amorous (adj.), amour (affair), paramour (lover).
normal.cn: 词族：amorous（多情的）、amour（恋情）、paramour（情人）。

normal.en: Cinema cue: Amour is an Oscar-winning French film about love.
normal.cn: 电影提示：《爱》是获奥斯卡奖的法国爱情片，片名即 amour。

normal.en: Add par- for paramour: the lover through (par) an amour.
normal.cn: 加 par- 成 paramour：穿过这段恋情的恋人。

normal.en: Register note: amour is literary; affair is everyday.
normal.cn: 语域提示：amour 偏书面，affair 是日常词。

abstract.en: A folded letter passed under a ballroom door — amour in one image.
abstract.cn: 舞厅门缝下递进的折起的信——一个画面就是 amour。

abstract.en: Two masked eyes at a Paris balcony at midnight.
abstract.cn: 午夜巴黎阳台上一双蒙面的眼睛。

abstract.en: Say 'a-MOOR' and picture love anchored secretly in a hidden harbor.
abstract.cn: 读 a-MOOR 时联想「秘密泊进港湾的爱」。

examples.en: The diaries reveal the statesman's lifelong amours.
examples.cn: 日记披露了这位政治家一生中的多段恋情。

examples.en: Scandal erupted when the princess's amour reached the press.
examples.cn: 王妃的恋情见报后，丑闻轰然爆发。

examples.en: Medieval poets celebrated the ideal of courtly amour.
examples.cn: 中世纪诗人歌颂典雅爱情理想。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿姆」——恋人们互相喊对方「阿姆（ma 母音倒装）」，亲昵到只肯低声叫，像藏着一段秘密恋情。

root: 拉丁语 amare（爱）→ amor（爱情）→ 古法语 amour → 十三世纪借入英语。同根词：amorous（多情的）、paramour（情人）、amateur（爱好者）、enamor（使迷恋）。

sensesIntro.en: Amour runs from hidden affairs through literary romance and courtly ritual love to the beloved person.
sensesIntro.cn: amour 从隐秘恋情出发，经文学浪漫与骑士式爱情，延伸到恋人本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: love that must hide its face
core.cn: 核心意象：必须蒙住脸的爱

branches.en: The hidden, improper relationship
branches.cn: 隐秘越界的恋爱关系

branches.en: Literary love as a subject
branches.cn: 作为文学主题的爱情

branches.en: Ritualized medieval courtly love
branches.cn: 仪式化的中世纪典雅爱情

branches.en: The person loved
branches.cn: 被爱的人

branches.en: Romance as elegant literary matter
branches.cn: 作为雅致文学素材的爱情

intro.en: Amour is pure amor dressed in French spelling, joined in English to a family of love words.
intro.cn: amour 就是换了法语拼写的 amor，在英语中汇入「爱」词家族。

latinIntro.en: Latin amor generates English words from passion to hobbies.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 amor 派生出英语中从爱情到爱好的众多词汇。

items.example: amor vincit omnia, love conquers all
items.exampleCN: amor vincit omnia 即「爱战胜一切」

definition_zh: 审美的；美学的；有审美情趣的；美学；审美观
definition_en: relating to beauty and the judgment of taste, pleasing in appearance, or the set of principles behind a style
core_image: 美术馆里，一个人退后两步，眯起眼打量整面墙的构图
scene: 展厅里灯光很暗，参观者却迟迟挪不动脚。 The gallery's aesthetic appeal drew crowds even on weekdays.
sceneCN: 这里的 aesthetic 是「审美的」（第 1 个义项：与美感判断有关的）；句意是这家画廊的审美吸引力连工作日都能引来人群。

pos.zh: 形容词：审美的；美学的；悦目的

derivatives.zh: 加 -s 构成，义为「美学（学科）」
由同一希腊词根构成，义为「唯美主义者；审美家」
加 -ally 构成，义为「在审美上；从美学角度」
加 -ism 构成，义为「唯美主义」

senses.title: Relating to beauty and taste
senses.definition: concerned with beauty, art, and judgments of taste rather than with usefulness
senses.definitionCN: 关涉美、艺术与品味判断，而不是实用性的
senses.example: The building has real aesthetic value, even if it is costly to heat.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋楼确有美学价值，尽管取暖费用很高。
senses.why: Greek aisthetikos meant 'of sense perception'; the word moved from what the senses take in to the special pleasure of beauty.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 aisthetikos 意为「与感官知觉有关的」；这个词从感官接收之物，转到美感带来的特殊愉悦。

senses.title: Pleasing in appearance
senses.definition: attractive or well designed in a way that shows good taste
senses.definitionCN: 在外观上悦目，或设计体现出良好品味
senses.example: The new bridge is aesthetic as well as strong.
senses.exampleCN: 这座新桥既结实又美观。
senses.why: When the adjective describes a thing rather than a study, it means the thing satisfies the taste that the first sense names.
senses.whyCN: 当这个形容词形容一件东西而不是一门学问时，它指该物满足了第一义项所说的那种品味。

senses.title: A set of principles of style
senses.definition: the ideas about beauty and style that shape a work, a movement, or a person's taste
senses.definitionCN: 塑造一件作品、一个流派或一个人品味的关于美与风格的理念
senses.example: The film's aesthetic owes much to 1970s photography.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影的审美风格很大程度上借鉴了七十年代的摄影。
senses.why: As a noun the word names not beauty itself but the system of ideas that decides what counts as beautiful.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时，这个词指的不是美本身，而是决定什么算美的那套理念系统。

intro.en: A Greek word about sense perception, made into a German science of beauty and then borrowed by English.
intro.cn: 一个关于感官知觉的希腊词，在德国被造成「美的学问」，随后被英语借走。

items.en: aisthesthai meant to perceive with the senses, to feel or notice something through the body.
items.cn: aisthesthai 意为用感官感知，通过身体去感觉或察觉。

items.en: aisthetikos meant 'of perception', concerned with what can be sensed rather than with pure thought.
items.cn: aisthetikos 意为「与知觉有关的」，关注可被感知之物，而非纯粹思想。

items.en: In the eighteenth century German writers made Aesthetik the name of a new discipline of beauty and art.
items.cn: 十八世纪德国作家把 Aesthetik 用作一门研究美与艺术的新学科之名。

items.en: English borrowed aesthetic from German, first as a term of philosophy and then of art criticism.
items.cn: 英语从德语借入 aesthetic，先作哲学术语，后进入艺术批评。

items.en: Everyday use now allows aesthetic to mean simply pleasing to look at, beyond its technical sense.
items.cn: 今天的日常用法让它超出专业范围，直接表示「看上去悦目」。

note.en: The first group shares the Greek root of perception; the second gathers words about beauty and style.
note.cn: 第一组共享表示「知觉」的希腊词根；第二组收关于美与风格的词。

entries.definition: the branch of philosophy that studies beauty
entries.definitionCN: 美学（哲学分支）

entries.definition: a person who cares greatly about beauty
entries.definitionCN: 审美家；唯美主义者

entries.definition: in terms of beauty or appearance
entries.definitionCN: 在审美上

entries.definition: a drug that removes feeling; same perception root, other prefix
entries.definitionCN: 麻醉剂；同词根但前缀不同，意思相反

entries.definition: relating to art or showing skill in art
entries.definitionCN: 艺术的；有艺术才能的

entries.definition: showing good judgment in beauty and style
entries.definitionCN: 有品味的；雅致的

entries.definition: pleasing to the senses; more emotional than aesthetic
entries.definitionCN: 美丽的；比 aesthetic 更带情感

entries.definition: relating to the manner of expression rather than beauty
entries.definitionCN: 风格上的；侧重表达方式

normalIntro.en: The root means perception: aesthetic is about what the senses judge as beautiful.
normalIntro.cn: 词根意为「知觉」：aesthetic 讲的是感官判定为美的东西。

normal.en: The Greek root aisthet- means perceive, so aesthetic is about felt beauty.
normal.cn: 希腊词根 aisthet- 意为「感知」，所以 aesthetic 关乎被感受到的美。

normal.en: An anesthetic removes perception; an aesthetic sharpens it.
normal.cn: anesthetic 去掉知觉，aesthetic 则磨锐知觉。

normal.en: Use aesthetically to describe how something looks.
normal.cn: 用 aesthetically 来描述某物看上去如何。

normal.en: An aesthete is a person who lives for beauty.
normal.cn: an aesthete 是为美而活的人。

normal.en: Spell it with ae-, and keep the th before the final -etic.
normal.cn: 拼写以 ae- 开头，结尾 -etic 前要先写 th。

abstract.en: Picture a visitor stepping back from a wall of paintings to judge the whole arrangement.
abstract.cn: 想象参观者从一整墙画前退后两步，判断整体布局。

abstract.en: See the same judgment applied to a bridge, where strength and shape must agree.
abstract.cn: 想象同一种判断落到一座桥上，强度与形状必须彼此相称。

abstract.en: Imagine the rules behind the judgment written down as a system of taste.
abstract.cn: 想象把判断背后的规则写成一套品味体系。

examples.en: The old factory has little aesthetic value but great historical interest.
examples.cn: 这座旧工厂没什么美学价值，却有很高的历史意义。

examples.en: Her garden is practical rather than aesthetic.
examples.cn: 她的花园重实用胜过美观。

examples.en: The designer explained the film's aesthetic in a short interview.
examples.cn: 设计师在简短访谈中解释了这部电影的审美取向。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊斯赛提克」——伊斯在美术馆里退后两步，赛着看谁的品味更高。

root: 希腊语 aisthetikos「与知觉有关的」来自 aisthesthai「感知」；十八世纪德语把它造成研究美的学科名，英语随后借入，兼指「审美的」「悦目的」与「审美观」。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses move from the study of beauty, to a thing that satisfies it, to the system of taste behind it.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项从研究美的学问，走到满足这种学问的东西，再到它背后的品味体系。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a visitor steps back to judge a whole wall of paintings.
core.cn: 核心意象：参观者退后两步，判断整墙画作。

branches.en: a listed building valued for beauty, not profit
branches.cn: 因美而非因盈利被珍视的登录建筑

branches.en: a question of taste rather than use
branches.cn: 关乎品味而非用途的问题

branches.en: a bridge whose shape pleases the eye
branches.cn: 外形悦目的桥

branches.en: a film borrowing the look of old photography
branches.cn: 借鉴旧摄影外观的电影

branches.en: perception, then pleasure, then the rules of pleasure
branches.cn: 先知觉，再愉悦，最后是愉悦的规则

intro.cn: 一个表示「感知」的希腊动词、它的形容词，加上英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The root is Greek; Latin borrowed it only as a learned term, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是希腊语；拉丁语只把它当作学术借词使用，因此这里不列拉丁词条。

definition_zh: 分配；份额；拨给的土地；（英）小块租种地
definition_en: an amount allotted to a person or purpose, or a small plot of land rented for growing vegetables
core_image: 写着你名字的一小块地/一份额
scene: 城边空地上排着一格格的小菜园。 Grandfather grows beans on his allotment.
sceneCN: 这里的 allotment 是「小块租种地」（第 3 个义项：英国城郊分给居民种菜的地块）；句意是爷爷在他的租种地上种豆子。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「分配；拨给」
拉丁同族名词，义为「配给；拨款」，更常用于经济语境

senses.title: The act of allotting
senses.definition: the act or process of allotting shares, funds, or tasks
senses.definitionCN: 分配份额、资金或任务的行为或过程
senses.example: The allotment of duties took all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 分派任务花了整个上午。
senses.why: The -ment suffix turns the verb allot into the action or its result.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ment 把动词 allot 转为动作或其结果。

senses.title: The share or amount allotted
senses.definition: the amount or quota allotted to a person, unit, or purpose
senses.definitionCN: 分给个人、单位或用途的数量或配额
senses.example: His allotment of grain was cut in half.
senses.exampleCN: 他的粮食配给被削减了一半。
senses.why: From the act to its concrete result: what you receive.
senses.whyCN: 由动作转到具体结果：你实际得到的份。

senses.title: A British vegetable plot for rent
senses.definition: in Britain, a small plot of land rented from a council for growing vegetables
senses.definitionCN: 英国指从市政租来种菜的小块土地
senses.example: There is a waiting list for allotments in the town.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上的租种地要排队等候。
senses.why: Land was literally allotted to townspeople; the grant hardened into the place name.
senses.whyCN: 土地确曾分配给市民；这种授予固化成了地名性的用法。

senses.title: A grant of land to a person or group
senses.definition: an official grant of land, especially historically to Native Americans or settlers
senses.definitionCN: 官方拨予的土地，尤指历史上给原住民或移民的份地
senses.example: Each family received a land allotment.
senses.exampleCN: 每户家庭获得一份拨地。
senses.why: The legal act of allotting land left a noun for the granted parcel itself.
senses.whyCN: 拨地这一法律行为留下了指称所拨地块本身的名词。

senses.title: A share of stock in issue
senses.definition: shares of a new issue assigned to an applicant
senses.definitionCN: 新股发行中分派给申购者的股份
senses.example: Her application got a small allotment of shares.
senses.exampleCN: 她的申购获得了少量股份配售。
senses.why: Finance keeps the drawing-of-lots flavor in distributing new issues.
senses.whyCN: 金融领域的配售保留了抽签分配的味道。

senses.title: A soldier's pay assigned to family
senses.definition: a portion of a soldier's pay assigned to dependents
senses.definitionCN: 军人薪饷中划给家属的部分
senses.example: He sent a monthly allotment home.
senses.exampleCN: 他每月往家里汇津贴。
senses.why: A fixed share of income formally assigned to someone.
senses.whyCN: 收入中被正式指派给某人的固定份额。

senses.title: A time allotment in schedules
senses.definition: a fixed amount of time set aside for an activity
senses.definitionCN: 为某活动设定的固定时长
senses.example: The exam's time allotment is three hours.
senses.exampleCN: 考试时间配额为三小时。
senses.why: The share logic extends neatly to clock time.
senses.whyCN: 份额逻辑顺延到钟表时间上。

senses.title: The distribution principle itself
senses.definition: allotment as a principle or system of distributing limited resources
senses.definitionCN: 分配有限资源的配给原则或制度
senses.example: The tribe opposed the allotment system.
senses.exampleCN: 部落反对配给制度。
senses.why: A repeated act can be discussed as an abstract system.
senses.whyCN: 反复进行的动作可被抽象为一种制度来讨论。

intro.en: Allotment is allot plus the noun suffix -ment, formed in English in the fifteenth century.
intro.cn: allotment 由 allot 加名词后缀 -ment 构成，十五世纪成形于英语。

items.en: Reconstructed *hluta-, "share by lot", behind lot.
items.cn: lot 背后的重构词形 *hluta-「抽签之份」。

items.cn: 古英语 hlot，定份额的抽签物。

items.en: allot formed from a- + lot.
items.cn: 中古英语由 a- + lot 构成 allot。

items.en: -ment, borrowed via French from Latin -mentum.
items.cn: 后缀 -ment 经法语借自拉丁语 -mentum。

items.cn: allotment 最初记录「分配」这一动作。

items.en: Senses cover quotas, British garden plots, and land grants.
items.cn: 义项涵盖配额、英国租种地与拨地。

note.en: Allotment competes with allocation in formal use, and pairs historically with the draw of lots.
note.cn: 正式语体中 allotment 与 allocation 相竞争，历史上与抽签搭配。
