core_image: 书桌上纸、笔、杯子挤成一堆
scene: 考完试的房间里，卷子摊在床上，袜子挂在椅背上。 Her desk stays untidy even when she has no homework.
sceneCN: 这里 untidy 是「凌乱的」（第 1 个义项：东西没放回原处）；句意为她即便没有作业，书桌也总是乱糟糟的。桌上纸笔杯子堆成一团的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 形容词加 -ly 构成副词，义为「凌乱地；潦草地」
形容词加 -ness 构成名词，义为「凌乱；不整洁」
去掉否定前缀后的肯定形式，义为「整洁的」
肯定形式加 -ly，义为「整齐地」

senses.title: Things left out of their proper places
senses.definition: with objects scattered about instead of being put away
senses.definitionCN: 东西散放着而没有收归原处
senses.example: The kitchen was untidy after the family dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 一家人吃过饭后厨房乱成一团。
senses.why: The prefix means not and the base means neat and in good order, so untidy begins as the plain opposite of tidy.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 un- 表示「不」，词根本义是「整齐、有条理」，因此 untidy 起初就是 tidy 的简单反面。

senses.title: A person careless about appearance
senses.definition: used of someone whose clothes and hair are not looked after
senses.definitionCN: 形容衣着头发不加打理的人
senses.example: He came to the interview looking untidy.
senses.exampleCN: 他来面试时一副不修边幅的样子。
senses.why: What is true of a room is also true of clothing: things are not put where they belong.
senses.whyCN: 房间如此，衣着也如此：东西都没待在它该在的位置上。

senses.title: Writing that is hard to read
senses.definition: used of handwriting or work that is messy on the page
senses.definitionCN: 形容字迹或版面上乱糟糟的
senses.example: Her untidy notes were hard to copy.
senses.exampleCN: 她潦草的笔记很难抄。
senses.why: Ink spread over a page without a line is the same clutter, moved from a room to a sheet of paper.
senses.whyCN: 一笔笔墨落在纸上不成行，就是同一种杂乱，只不过从房间搬到了纸面。

senses.title: Thinking or a plan without order
senses.definition: used of ideas or plans that lack a clear structure
senses.definitionCN: 形容想法或计划缺少清晰结构
senses.example: The untidy argument lost the reader halfway.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇论证条理不清，读到一半就跟丢了。
senses.why: If objects can sit out of place, so can the steps of a thought, and this abstract sense follows directly.
senses.whyCN: 既然物件能不在原位，思绪的步骤也可以，这层抽象义就是这样顺势而来的。

senses.title: A situation that looks poorly managed
senses.titleCN: 不整齐的；显得没管好的
senses.definition: used of a business or process that looks badly organised
senses.definitionCN: 形容生意或流程显得管理不善
senses.example: The shop looked untidy and understaffed on a Saturday.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店星期六看上去乱糟糟的，人手也不够。
senses.why: A trade that is not kept in order looks untidy, just as a room does.
senses.whyCN: 一桩没人打理的生意看上去乱糟糟，这和一间房的道理一样。

intro.en: A native negative prefix on an adjective that goes back to an old word for time.
intro.cn: 本土否定前缀压在一个可追溯至古老「时间」词的形容词上。

items.en: The prefix un- is native and turns a word into its opposite.
items.cn: 前缀 un- 为英语本土成分，把一个词翻成反义。

items.en: Tid meant time or season, and the adjective tidlic meant timely or in good season.
items.cn: tid 意为「时间、时令」，形容词 tidlic 意为「及时的、合时令的」。

items.en: Tidy shifts from timely to neat, and its spelling settles in this period.
items.cn: tidy 从「及时」转为「整洁」，拼写也在这一时期定型。

items.en: Untidy appears with the sense of things out of order and leaves the old time sense behind.
items.cn: untidy 出现时已是「东西乱了次序」的意思，旧有的时间义被丢掉。

items.en: The word extends to dress, handwriting, and plans that show no order.
items.cn: 此后这个词扩展到衣着、字迹以及毫无条理的计划。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the tidy family and similar un- spellings, while the near-meaning group collects messy words.
note.cn: 形近组沿 tidy 词族及相似的 un- 拼写展开，近义组汇集表示杂乱的说法。

entries.definition: neat and in order
entries.definitionCN: 整洁的

entries.definition: in a neat way
entries.definitionCN: 整齐地

entries.definition: neatness
entries.definitionCN: 整洁

entries.definition: in a messy way
entries.definitionCN: 凌乱地

entries.definition: not firm or stable
entries.definitionCN: 不稳的（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: dirty and badly arranged
entries.definitionCN: 凌乱的

entries.definition: lacking order
entries.definitionCN: 无秩序的

entries.definition: dirty and untidy in appearance
entries.definitionCN: 邋遢的

entries.definition: clean and in order
entries.definitionCN: 整洁的

normalIntro.en: The word is the familiar negative of an everyday adjective, and its history lies in an old word for time.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是日常形容词的常见否定形式，其历史藏在一个古老的「时间」词里。

normal.en: Un- plus tidy: the positive word means neat and in order.
normal.cn: un- 加 tidy：肯定形式意为整齐有序。

normal.en: An untidy room and an untidy desk are the most frequent collocations.
normal.cn: an untidy room 与 an untidy desk 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: Tidy itself once meant timely, which explains why neat things are in season.
normal.cn: tidy 本义为「合时令」，这解释了为什么整洁东西总在恰当的时候出现。

normal.en: The noun is untidiness, the adverb untidily.
normal.cn: 名词是 untidiness，副词是 untidily。

normal.en: Messy is more spoken, untidy more neutral in writing.
normal.cn: messy 更口语，untidy 在书面中更中性。

abstract.en: See a desk with papers sliding into a pile.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子，纸片一点点滑成一堆。

abstract.en: Notice a tie worn with a shirt that is not ironed.
abstract.cn: 注意一条领带配着没熨平的衬衫。

abstract.en: Hear a drawer being pushed shut on clothes that will not fit.
abstract.cn: 听抽屉被硬推着关上，衣服塞不进去。

examples.en: His room is always untidy, with books on the floor.
examples.cn: 他的房间总是很乱，书都摊在地上。

examples.en: She came to the meeting looking untidy and out of breath.
examples.cn: 她来开会时一副不修边幅、气喘吁吁的样子。

examples.en: The untidy handwriting made the list hard to read.
examples.cn: 潦草的字迹让这份名单很难辨认。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺太脏」——屋里东西堆得乱，自己也不好意思，只能承认俺这屋实在太乱。

root: 英语本土构词：前缀 un-（不）+ tidy（整洁的），tidy 源自中古英语 tidy，再往上为古英语 tid（时间、时令）加上形容词词尾 -y，本义「合时令的」

sensesIntro.en: One core state, objects outside their proper place, spreads from rooms to clothes, writing, plans, and business.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个核心状态「东西不在原位」，从房间蔓延到衣着、字迹、计划与生意。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a desk where papers, pens, and cups have piled up.
core.cn: 核心意象：纸、笔与杯子在桌上堆成一团。

branches.en: The room branch: things never got put back.
branches.cn: 房间分支：东西一直没收回去。

branches.en: The person branch: clothes and hair left as they are.
branches.cn: 人物分支：衣着头发都随它去。

branches.en: The page branch: letters that will not stand in line.
branches.cn: 页面分支：字母站不成行。

branches.en: The mind branch: steps of a plan in no fixed order.
branches.cn: 思路分支：计划步骤没有固定次序。

branches.en: The business branch: a process nobody has organised.
branches.cn: 经营分支：没人管过流程的事。

intro.en: A native negative prefix over an adjective whose root once named a point in time.
intro.cn: 本土否定前缀压在一个词根曾指「时节」的形容词上。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic rather than Latin; the closest Latin idea is tempus, time.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根属日耳曼语而非拉丁语；概念上最近的拉丁词是 tempus（时间）。

items.example: Tid survives in the word tidings.
items.exampleCN: tid 仍存在于 tidings 一词中。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的名词后缀

items.example: Papers lay untidily on the floor.

definition_zh: 灰白的；苍白的；像灰烬的；死灰色的
definition_en: pale gray in color, especially the gray-white of a shocked or frightened face
core_image: 听到噩耗后一瞬间血色尽失的脸
scene: 电话那头传来坏消息，她扶住桌沿，脸色瞬间褪成一片灰白。 Her face turned ashen when she read the telegram.
sceneCN: 这里 ashen 是「灰白的、死灰色的」（第 1 个义项：形容惊恐后的脸色）；句意是她读电报时脸色变得灰白。

derivatives.zh: 基础名词，义为「灰烬；灰」
复合形容词，义为「面色灰白的」
由 ash 加后缀构成，义为「灰的；覆灰的」

senses.title: Pale from shock or fear
senses.definition: pale and gray, describing a face drained by fear or illness
senses.definitionCN: 苍白带灰，形容被恐惧或疾病抽干血色的脸
senses.example: The witness went ashen as he described the crash.
senses.exampleCN: 目击者描述事故时脸色变得死灰。
senses.why: Ash, the cold gray powder of burned wood, gives its color to a face emptied of blood.
senses.whyCN: 灰烬是木头燃尽后的冷灰色粉末，把这种颜色给了失去血色的脸。

senses.title: Gray like ashes
senses.definition: of a gray color like wood ash
senses.definitionCN: 像木灰一样的灰色
senses.example: After the wildfire, an ashen haze covered the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 山火过后，灰蒙蒙的烟霭笼罩山谷。
senses.why: The color comparison extends from faces to skies and landscapes.
senses.whyCN: 颜色比喻从脸色扩展到天空与景色。

intro.en: Ashen is ash plus the Old English adjectival suffix -en, meaning made of or like.
intro.cn: ashen 由 ash（灰烬）加古英语形容词后缀 -en（由…制成／像…）构成。

items.en: The reconstructed root *askon meant burnt remains.
items.cn: 重构词根 *askon 指燃烧后的残余。

items.en: Asce meant ash, the powder left after burning.
items.cn: 古英语 asce 指灰烬。

items.en: The suffix -en made adjectives of material, as in wooden and golden.
items.cn: 后缀 -en 构成材质形容词，如 wooden、golden。

items.en: Middle English aschen first meant made of ash, then ash-colored.
items.cn: 中古英语 aschen 先指灰烬制的，后指灰色的。

items.en: Modern English favors the pale-face sense.
items.cn: 现代英语更常用「脸色灰白」义。

note.en: Ashen is stronger than pale: it carries the gray of ashes and a hint of dread.
note.cn: ashen 比 pale 更强：带有灰烬的灰色与一丝不祥。

entries.definition: having a pale gray face
entries.definitionCN: 面色灰白的

entries.definition: the gray powder left by fire; also a tree
entries.definitionCN: 灰烬；白蜡树

entries.definition: covered with or like ash
entries.definitionCN: 覆灰的；灰色的

entries.definition: of the pale gray of ashes
entries.definitionCN: 灰烬灰色的

entries.definition: similar ending but different root entirely
entries.definitionCN: 湾状构造（拼写后缀相似，词源不同）

entries.definition: unhealthy pale
entries.definitionCN: 病态的苍白

entries.definitionCN: 憔悴苍白的

entries.definition: of the color between black and white
entries.definitionCN: 灰色的

entries.definition: deathly pale with terror
entries.definitionCN: 惨白的；可怕的

normalIntro.en: See ash + -en: a face the color of a cold fireplace.
normalIntro.cn: 记住 ash + -en：一张冷灰如熄灭壁炉的脸。

normal.en: -en makes material adjectives: wooden, golden, ashen.
normal.cn: -en 构成材质形容词：wooden、golden、ashen。

normal.en: the shock sense drains blood to leave ash color.
normal.cn: 惊吓抽走血色，留下灰烬之色。

normal.en: compare pallid and wan for other pale words.
normal.cn: 比较 pallid、wan 等其他「苍白」词。

normal.en: an ashen sky mirrors the dying fire.
normal.cn: 铅灰的天空映着将熄的火。

normal.en: ash the tree and ash the powder are different words.
normal.cn: 白蜡树与灰烬是两个不同的同形词。

abstract.en: Picture a fireplace the morning after: cold and gray.
abstract.cn: 想象壁炉过后的清晨：冰冷灰暗。

abstract.en: Feel the blood draining downward like ash settling.
abstract.cn: 感觉血色像落灰一样沉降下去。

abstract.en: See a landscape wrapped in a gray burial veil.
abstract.cn: 想象被灰色裹尸布罩住的风景。

examples.en: He turned ashen at the news of the accident.
examples.cn: 听到事故消息，他的脸变得灰白。

examples.en: An ashen dawn rose over the burned hills.
examples.cn: 灰蒙蒙的黎明在烧焦的山丘上降临。

examples.en: Her ashen lips could barely speak.
examples.cn: 她惨白的嘴唇几乎说不出话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿申」——阿（苦）得申不出话，脸都灰了，正如 ashen 的死灰色。

root: ash（古英语 asce，灰烬）+ -en（古英语材质形容词后缀），义为「像灰烬的、灰白的」。

sensesIntro.en: The gray of burnt wood colors first faces in shock, then skies and land after fire.
sensesIntro.cn: 烧尽木头的灰色先给受惊的脸着色，再给火灾后的天空与大地着色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a face the color of cold ashes
core.cn: 核心意象：一张冷灰如烬的脸

branches.en: pallor of fear or illness
branches.cn: 恐惧或病中的苍白

branches.en: the gray of ashes on things
branches.cn: 事物的灰烬色

branches.en: the coldness of the color
branches.cn: 颜色自带的冷意

branches.en: scenes of ruin after fire
branches.cn: 火灾后的残破景象

branches.en: a face emptied of blood
branches.cn: 血色尽失的脸

intro.en: The Old English -en suffix still builds material adjectives in modern English.
intro.cn: 古英语后缀 -en 至今仍用于构成材质形容词。

latinIntro.en: Ash is a native Germanic word, so there are no Latin cognates.
latinIntro.cn: ash 是日耳曼本族词，没有拉丁同源词。

definition_zh: 分期付款；一期；一集；部分
definition_en: one of several regular payments for a debt; one part of a series
core_image: 一本日历，每个月都被划掉一个方格，方格上标着小小的金额数字
scene: 小丽想买一台最新款的电脑，商店说可以分十期付，每期两百块。 She decided the installment plan was easier than paying all at once.
sceneCN: 这里 installment 指「分期付款的一期」（第 1 个义项：债务的定期分期付款之一）；句意为他们选择分月付而不是一次性付清。图中可辨识物件：日历、电脑、分期付款收据。

pos.zh: 分期付款（可数）；一集（可数）

derivatives.zh: 安装；设立
安装；设施
安装人员
分期付款方案
装置艺术

senses.title: regular debt payment
senses.definition: one of a series of scheduled payments to settle a debt
senses.definitionCN: 结清债务的一系列预定付款之一
senses.example: The loan required twelve monthly instalments.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔贷款要求分十二个月偿还。
senses.why: The root is install, 'to set up', as in setting up a schedule of payments.
senses.whyCN: 词根是 install「设立」，就像设立一个付款日程。

senses.title: part of a purchase
senses.definition: one part of the price of an item paid over time
senses.definitionCN: 一件商品的价格中按时间分批支付的一部分
senses.example: They bought the fridge on easy instalments.
senses.exampleCN: 他们以轻松分期的方式买下了冰箱。
senses.why: A purchase that you set up with a payment plan.
senses.whyCN: 通过付款计划设立的一笔消费。

senses.title: episode of a story
senses.definition: one episode of a serial story, television show or podcast
senses.definitionCN: 连载故事、电视剧或播客的一集
senses.example: The novel was published in monthly instalments.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说按月连载。
senses.why: A story set up to come out piece by piece.
senses.whyCN: 被设立成一段一段推出的故事。

senses.title: stage of a plan
senses.definition: one stage of an overall plan or project
senses.definitionCN: 整体计划或项目的一个阶段
senses.example: The first instalment of the highway opened in 2024.
senses.exampleCN: 高速公路的一期在 2024 年通车。
senses.why: A large work set up as a series of smaller bits.
senses.whyCN: 一项大工程被设立成若干小块。

senses.title: artwork installation
senses.definition: a large artwork set up in a specific space
senses.definitionCN: 设立在特定空间里的大型艺术作品
senses.example: The museum commissioned a new instalment.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆委托创作了一件新的装置作品。
senses.why: A work that is installed, set up in a space.
senses.whyCN: 一件被 install、设立在空间里的作品。

senses.title: initial payment
senses.definition: the first payment in a series
senses.definitionCN: 一系列付款中的第一笔
senses.example: The first instalment was due on delivery.
senses.exampleCN: 首期款在交货时到期。
senses.why: The first of the scheduled pieces.
senses.whyCN: 预定的几块中的第一块。

senses.title: supplement or tranche
senses.definition: a supplementary sum of money released over time
senses.definitionCN: 随时间分批释放的一笔追加资金
senses.example: The donor promised a second instalment in 2026.
senses.exampleCN: 捐赠者承诺 2026 年捐出第二期款项。
senses.why: Money set up to come in slices.
senses.whyCN: 被设立成一片片进来的钱。

senses.title: scheduled meeting
senses.definition: a scheduled session of a course or training programme
senses.definitionCN: 课程或培训项目预定的一节课
senses.example: The leadership course had six fortnightly instalments.
senses.exampleCN: 这个领导力课程分六次，每两周一次。
senses.why: A course set up as pieces over time.
senses.whyCN: 一门被设立成若干块、按时间推出的课程。

intro.en: Instalment comes from install 'to set up, arrange' + -ment. Install itself came from Old French installer, from Latin installare.
intro.cn: instalment 来自 install「设立、安排」+ -ment。install 本身来自古法语 installer，后者来自拉丁语 installare。

items.en: Latin installare meant 'to place in a seat, to install in an office'; it was in- 'in' + stallum 'seat, stall'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 installare 意为「安置在座位上、任命」，由 in-「在……里」+ stallum「座位、栏」构成。

items.en: Old French installer meant 'to install, establish'.
items.cn: 古法语 installer 意为「安装、设立」。

items.en: English install was borrowed around 1400 meaning 'to place formally, to establish'.
items.cn: 英语 install 约 1400 年从古法语借入，意为「正式安置、设立」。

items.en: Instalment was formed from install + -ment around 1560, first meaning 'an arrangement, a setting up'.
items.cn: instalment 约 1560 年由 install + -ment 构成，最初意为「一个安排、一次设立」。

items.en: The 'partial payment' sense developed from the idea of 'setting up a debt to be paid in parts', by the 18th century.
items.cn: 「分期付款」义来自「设立一笔要分几块还的债」的想法，18 世纪形成。

items.en: Installment (US) and instalment (UK) are both standard; the Latin root stallum is well attested.
items.cn: 美式 installment 和英式 instalment 都是标准拼写；拉丁词根 stallum 来源可靠。

note.en: Look-alikes share the install root; near meanings are one of several payments or parts.
note.cn: 形近共享 install 词根；近义是若干付款或部分中的一个。

entries.definition: To set up or place; instalment is the noun of a piece of what is set up.
entries.definitionCN: 设立、安置；instalment 是被设立的东西的一块。

entries.definition: The act of installing, or a facility set up.
entries.definitionCN: 安装行为，或设立的设施。

entries.definition: A person who installs something.
entries.definitionCN: 安装工。

entries.definition: A seat or enclosure, from the Latin stallum.
entries.definitionCN: 座位或栏，来自拉丁语 stallum。

entries.definition: Any amount paid, not necessarily part of a scheduled series.
entries.definitionCN: 任何支付的金额，不一定是预定系列中的一部分。

entries.definition: One scheduled piece of a larger whole.
entries.definitionCN: 更大整体中预定好的一块。

entries.definition: A slice of money released over time; usually financial.
entries.definitionCN: 按时间分批释放的一笔资金块；通常指财务。

entries.definition: One part of a serial story, same as the story sense of instalment.
entries.definitionCN: 连载故事的一部分，跟 instalment 的故事义相同。

normalIntro.en: Real morphemes and real compounds.
normalIntro.cn: 真实构词与真实复合。

normal.en: install 'to set up' + -ment = a piece of what has been set up (schedule, series, debt).
normal.cn: install「设立」+ -ment = 被设立的东西（日程、系列、债务）中的一块。

normal.en: stallum is Latin for 'seat, stall'; installare means 'to place in a seat'.
normal.cn: stallum 拉丁语意为「座位、栏」；installare 意为「安置在座位上」。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: monthly instalment, pay in instalments, instalment plan.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：monthly instalment 月供、pay in instalments 分期付、instalment plan 分期方案。

normal.en: install, installation, instalment are a tidy family.
normal.cn: install、installation、instalment 是整齐的同族。

normal.en: US uses -ll-: installment; UK uses -l-: instalment.
normal.cn: 美式双 l 拼 installment，英式单 l 拼 instalment。

abstract.en: Picture a wall with bricks being laid one by one, each brick an instalment.
abstract.cn: 想象一面墙一块块砌起来，每一块砖就是一期。

abstract.en: Picture a judge installing a judge on the bench, then the bench splits into twelve pieces.
abstract.cn: 想象一个法官坐在宝座上，然后宝座分裂成十二块。

abstract.en: Picture each month a piece of your debt falls off.
abstract.cn: 想象每个月你的债务就掉下一块。

examples.en: She chose an interest-free instalment plan to buy her first camera.
examples.cn: 她选择了免息分期方案买下了自己的第一台相机。

examples.en: The author released the novel in weekly instalments through an online platform.
examples.cn: 作者通过网络平台把这部小说按周连载。

examples.en: Only after the final instalment was paid did the title to the car transfer to her.
examples.cn: 只有在最后一期付清后，汽车的所有权才转移到她名下。

dict_mnemonic.text: install（设立）+ -ment = 被设立的一件事被拆成几块 → 分期

root: 拉丁语 installare（in-「在……里」+ stallum「座位、栏」）→ 古法语 installer → 英语 install + -ment → instalment。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses progress from scheduled debt payment → part of a purchase → story episode → project stage → artwork → initial payment → supplementary funds → course session.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从预定债务付款 → 购买款的一部分 → 故事一集 → 项目阶段 → 装置艺术 → 首期 → 追加资金 → 课程一节课。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a calendar where each month you place one small coin on the debt.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本日历，每个月你都往债务上放一枚小硬币。

branches.en: THE FINANCIAL SLICE: one part of a payment plan for debt or purchase.
branches.cn: 财务上的一块：债务或购买款付款计划中的一部分。

branches.en: THE STORY SLICE: one episode of a serial work.
branches.cn: 故事上的一块：连载作品的一集。

branches.en: THE CONSTRUCTION SLICE: a project stage or an artwork installation.
branches.cn: 工程上的一块：项目阶段或装置艺术。

branches.en: THE FUND SLICE: the first or a supplementary tranche.
branches.cn: 资金上的一块：首期或追加的一笔。

branches.en: THE EDUCATIONAL SLICE: one scheduled session of a course.
branches.cn: 教育上的一块：课程的一节预定课。

intro.en: Installment = install + -ment. Install ← French installer ← Latin installare.
intro.cn: installment = install + -ment。install ← 法 installer ← 拉丁 installare。

latinIntro.en: Latin installare = in- + stallum. stallum = seat, stall.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 installare = in- + stallum。stallum = 座位、栏。

items.example: You install a schedule of payments.

items.meaning: a piece of what is installed
items.example: Each payment is one instalment of the schedule.
items.exampleCN: 每一次付款就是日程里的一期。

items.example: The root is a physical seat or stall.
items.exampleCN: 词根是一个物理的座位或栏。

items.example: in- puts you into the stallum.

items.structure: Old English steall, related to Latin stallum
items.meaning: a seat, a booth, or to be stuck
items.example: Stall shares a root with Latin stallum.
items.exampleCN: stall 与拉丁语 stallum 同根。

items.meaning: the act of installing or a facility
items.example: A power station is an installation.
The installer came to fit the new dishwasher.
Instalment is the result of install + -ment.
items.exampleCN: Instalment 是 install + -ment 的结果。
Installation 用的是另一个后缀 -ation。

items.example: Reinstall the software if it stalls.
items.exampleCN: 如果软件卡住了就重装。

latinEntries.meaning: to place in a seat; to install

definition_zh: n. 工艺品；美术器皿（统称，不可数）
definition_en: Decorative objects such as ceramics, glass and metal pieces considered together as a class of goods rather than as single works.
core_image: 货架上一排排只为好看而做的瓶瓶罐罐
scene: 橱窗里摆着一排青瓷花瓶与铜盘。 The window displayed Chinese artware in blue and bronze.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：artware 是工艺品的统称，把它当一类货品来看，而不是单件作品。

derivatives.zh: 艺术品；插图
艺术的；有美感的
器皿；货品
手工艺人

senses.title: Decorative objects as a class
senses.titleCN: 作为一类货品的装饰器物
senses.definition: ceramics, glass, metal and similar pieces made mainly to be looked at, spoken of together
senses.definitionCN: 主要为观赏而做的陶瓷、玻璃、金属等器物，作为一个整体来谈
senses.example: The museum shop sells local artware.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆商店出售本地工艺品。
senses.why: The second half, ware, means goods, so the word counts things by shelf rather than by masterpiece.
senses.whyCN: 后半 ware 意为「货品」，所以这个词是按货架而不是按杰作来数东西的。

senses.title: A trade category
senses.definition: the heading used in shops, catalogues and customs lists for decorative goods
senses.definitionCN: 商店、目录与报关清单上用来归类装饰性货品的名目
senses.example: Artware forms a separate line in the export list.
senses.exampleCN: 工艺品在出口清单上单列一项。
senses.why: Because the word names a class of goods, it fits invoices and catalogues where artwork would sound too grand.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个词指的是一类货品，它适合发票与目录，而 artwork 在那里显得过于隆重。

intro.en: Artware joins art, from Latin ars, skill, to ware, from Old English waru, goods: skill turned into things for sale.
intro.cn: artware 由 art（源自拉丁语 ars「技艺」）与 ware（源自古英语 waru「货品」）拼成：技艺变成了可售的物件。

items.en: Latin ars meant skill or craft, the trained ability to make something well.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ars 意为「技艺、手艺」，即把东西做好的训练出来的能力。

items.en: Old French art carried the Latin sense of skill into the western languages.
items.cn: 古法语 art 把拉丁语「技艺」的意思带入西部各语言。

items.en: Old English waru meant goods or wares, the things a trader carries, and survives in hardware and silverware.
items.cn: 古英语 waru 意为「货品」，即商人携带之物，如今仍留在 hardware 与 silverware 中。

items.en: English ware came to name a whole class of made things, usually joined to the material or purpose.
items.cn: 英语 ware 转而指一整类制成品，通常与材料或用途拼合使用。

items.en: Nineteenth-century trade English joined the two halves to name decorative goods sold in quantity.
items.cn: 十九世纪的商贸英语把两半拼起来，指成批出售的装饰性货品。

items.en: Twentieth-century catalogues and customs lists kept artware as a heading beside ceramics and glassware.
items.cn: 二十世纪的目录与报关清单把 artware 与陶瓷、玻璃器皿并列，作为一个品类名目保留下来。

note.en: The look-alike group splits the two halves of the compound; the near-meaning group names the crafts that fill the shelf.
note.cn: 形近组把这个复合词的两半拆开来比；近义组列出填满货架的各类手艺名称。

entries.definition: A finished piece of art or an illustration.
entries.definitionCN: 一件完成的美术作品或插图。

entries.definition: Tools and metal goods, or computer parts.
entries.definitionCN: 工具与金属制品，或计算机硬件。

entries.definition: Pottery fired at a low temperature.
entries.definitionCN: 低温烧制的陶器。

entries.definition: Clever in a crafty, slightly sly way.
entries.definitionCN: 机灵而略带狡黠的。

entries.definition: Objects made from fired clay.
entries.definitionCN: 烧制黏土做成的器物。

entries.definition: Work made skilfully by hand.
entries.definitionCN: 用手精巧做出的活计。

entries.definition: Things produced by a skilled craft.
entries.definitionCN: 由熟练手艺做出的东西。

entries.definition: An object kept only for decoration.
entries.definitionCN: 纯为装饰而摆放的物件。

normalIntro.en: Artware is art plus ware, goods: skill on a shelf, priced by the piece rather than hung in a gallery.
normalIntro.cn: artware 就是 art 加 ware「货品」：摆在货架上的技艺，按件标价，而不是挂进美术馆。

normal.en: Ware always means a class of goods.
normal.cn: ware 一律表示一类货品。

normal.en: Hardware, silverware and glassware follow the same pattern.
normal.cn: hardware、silverware、glassware 都是同一构词法。

normal.en: Artware is uncountable, so use a piece of artware.
normal.cn: artware 不可数，要说 a piece of artware。

normal.en: Artwork is one piece, artware is the whole shelf.
normal.cn: artwork 是一件，artware 是整架。

normal.en: The word belongs to shops and catalogues.
normal.cn: 这个词属于商店与商品目录。

abstract.en: Picture a shelf of blue vases waiting for buyers.
abstract.cn: 想象一架青花瓶等着买主。

abstract.en: Imagine a customs form with one box for decorative goods.
abstract.cn: 想象报关单上有一个「装饰货品」的格子。

abstract.en: Think of skill packed into a crate for shipping.
abstract.cn: 想象技艺被装箱待运。

examples.en: The stall was piled with painted artware.
examples.cn: 摊子上堆满彩绘工艺品。

examples.en: She buys artware whenever she travels.
examples.cn: 她每次旅行都会买工艺品。

examples.en: Artware and textiles fill the lower floor.
examples.cn: 工艺品与织物占满了下一层。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：art「艺术」+ ware「器皿、货品」——摆成货卖的艺术品，就是工艺品 artware。

root: 拉丁语 ars「技艺」经古法语 art 入英语；古英语 waru「货品」给出 ware；十九世纪商贸英语把两者拼成 artware，指成批出售的装饰器物。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses treat beauty as stock: objects made to be looked at, and the catalogue heading under which they are shipped and sold.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都把「美」当作库存：为观赏而做的器物，以及它们被运输与销售时所归入的目录名目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: shelves of jars and vases made only to be looked at
core.cn: 核心意象：货架上一排排只为好看而做的瓶瓶罐罐

branches.en: Blue vases and bronze plates in a window.
branches.cn: 橱窗里的青花瓶与铜盘。

branches.en: A stall piled with painted pieces.
branches.cn: 堆满彩绘器物的摊子。

branches.en: One line on an export list.
branches.cn: 出口清单上单列的一项。

branches.en: A heading beside ceramics and glassware.
branches.cn: 与陶瓷、玻璃器皿并列的名目。

branches.en: Beauty counted as stock, not as masterpieces.
branches.cn: 把美当库存来数，而不是当杰作。

intro.en: Artware is art plus -ware; the same goods ending builds hardware, glassware and silverware, while art adds -istic and -isan.
intro.cn: artware 是 art 加 -ware；同一「货品」后缀构成 hardware、glassware 与 silverware，而 art 一侧则派生出 -istic 与 -isan 一类形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is ars, skill, artifex, a skilled maker, and artificium, a crafted thing; the ware half stays Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语层次是 ars「技艺」、artifex「巧匠」与 artificium「手工制品」；ware 那一半仍是日耳曼来源。

latinEntries.example: Ars opens the whole art family.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ars 是整个 art 词族的起点。

definition_zh: 勤勉的；刻苦的；一丝不苟的；殷勤备至的
definition_en: showing great care, attention, and persistent effort in work or duty
core_image: 清晨到深夜都不离开书桌的学生
scene: 图书馆闭馆的铃声响了，他仍在灯下逐行核对译稿，笔记本边缘已被手指磨得发亮。 The assiduous student revised every footnote before dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 assiduous 是「勤勉的、一丝不苟的」（第 1 个义项：对工作持续用心）；句意为这位勤奋的学生在黎明前核完了每条脚注。

derivatives.zh: 同根名词，义为「勤勉；殷勤」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「勤勉地」
由形容词加名词后缀构成，义为「勤勉」

senses.title: Showing persistent care and effort
senses.definition: giving constant and careful effort to a task
senses.definitionCN: 对任务付出持续而细致的努力
senses.example: Her assiduous preparation won the debate.
senses.exampleCN: 她的刻苦备战赢得了辩论。
senses.why: Latin assiduus meant sitting beside the work, so the adjective describes one who never leaves the task.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 assiduus 意为「坐在工作旁」，形容词描绘寸步不离任务的人。

senses.title: Attentive and courteous to others
senses.definition: showing constant attentive service toward a person
senses.definitionCN: 对人表现出持续的细心侍奉
senses.example: The assiduous waiter refilled glasses before anyone asked.
senses.exampleCN: 殷勤的侍者不等人开口便续上了水。
senses.why: Staying seated beside a guest becomes staying close in service.
senses.whyCN: 「坐在宾客身旁不离」化作侍奉中的常伴左右。

intro.en: Assiduous comes from Latin assiduus, constant, literally sitting beside, from assidere.
intro.cn: assiduous 源自拉丁语 assiduus（持续的，字面为「坐在旁侧」），出自 assidere。

items.en: The root *sed- meant to sit.
items.cn: 词根 *sed- 意为坐。

items.en: Assidere meant to sit beside or attend to.
items.cn: 拉丁语 assidere 意为坐在旁侧、侍奉。

items.en: Assiduus described one who stays at the task without leaving.
items.cn: assiduus 形容坚守岗位不离的人。

items.en: English borrowed assiduous in the sixteenth century alongside assiduity.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语与 assiduity 一同借入 assiduous。

items.en: It now labels both tireless work and attentive care.
items.cn: 如今它既形容不倦的工作，也形容周到的照料。

note.en: Assiduous keeps the image of staying seated until the job is done.
note.cn: assiduous 保留了「坐定不动直到完工」的画面。

entries.definition: the noun for persistent diligence
entries.definitionCN: 勤勉（同根名词）

entries.definition: with steady diligence
entries.definitionCN: 勤勉地

entries.definition: diligent, from the same sitting root via Latin
entries.definitionCN: 勤奋的（同出「坐」词根）

entries.definition: similar letters, but means treacherous, from a sitting root in a bad sense
entries.definitionCN: 阴险的（拼写相近，词源同「坐」但义贬）

entries.definition: similar rhythm, different Latin root entirely
entries.definitionCN: 贪得的（节奏相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: careful and hardworking
entries.definitionCN: 勤奋的

entries.definition: persistently hardworking
entries.definitionCN: 孜孜不倦的

entries.definition: continuing despite difficulty
entries.definitionCN: 坚持不懈的

entries.definition: habitually busy and hardworking
entries.definitionCN: 勤劳的

entries.definition: extremely careful about details
entries.definitionCN: 一丝不苟的

normalIntro.en: Hear a-sid-you-ous: a-sitting-you-are, glued to the desk.
normalIntro.cn: 「额西丢」→联想「额习读」：额日日习读不辍，正是 assiduous 的勤勉。

normal.en: assiduus: seated beside the work.
normal.cn: assiduus：坐在工作旁不离。

normal.en: assiduous is the adjective; assiduity the noun.
normal.cn: assiduous 是形容词，assiduity 是名词。

normal.en: sedulous shares the sitting idea.
normal.cn: sedulous 共享「坐」的意象。

normal.en: plural attention sense appears in assiduous care.
normal.cn: assiduous care 体现周到照料义。

normal.en: insidious looks close but means treacherous.
normal.cn: insidious 拼写相近但意为阴险。

abstract.en: Picture candle wax hardened beside an open book.
abstract.cn: 想象摊开的书旁凝住的烛泪。

abstract.en: See one chair worn smooth by daily sitting.
abstract.cn: 看见一把被日日端坐磨光了的椅子。

abstract.en: Feel the hush of early morning study hours.
abstract.cn: 体会清晨自习时段的静谧。

examples.en: An assiduous editor caught every stray comma.
examples.cn: 一位一丝不苟的编辑抓住了每个多余的逗号。

examples.en: The assiduous nurse checked on him every hour.
examples.cn: 殷勤的护士每小时查看他一次。

examples.en: Assiduous practice made the pianist fluent.
examples.cn: 刻苦的练习让钢琴家琴艺纯熟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额西丢额斯」——额把西窗书读透从不丢下功课，是为 assiduous 的刻苦。

root: 拉丁语 assidere（坐在旁侧）→ assiduus（不离其位的、持续的）→ 英语 assiduous（勤勉的），核心意象是「与工作同席」。

sensesIntro.en: Staying seated at the task yields both tireless work and devoted care.
sensesIntro.cn: 「不离席位」既化作不倦的工作，也化作贴身的照料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chair never left until the work is done
core.cn: 核心意象：工作未成、不离座椅

branches.en: tireless effort on work
branches.cn: 对工作的不倦努力

branches.en: attentive service to persons
branches.cn: 对他人的悉心照料

branches.en: unbroken presence beside task or person
branches.cn: 与任务或人形影不离

branches.en: patience over long stretches
branches.cn: 长时段中的耐心

branches.en: courteous attentiveness
branches.cn: 礼貌周到的关照

intro.en: The sitting root links diligence with presence: to work is to stay.
intro.cn: 「坐」词根把勤勉与在场相连：工作即留守。

latinIntro.en: Latin assidere and assiduus anchor this family of steadfastness.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 assidere 与 assiduus 是这一「坚守」词族的锚点。
